Friend,

I hate to say this - but we're about to miss one of our upcoming fundraising deadlines.

This was one of the biggest pushes we've had so far this year -- and it is troubling to tell you we're about to miss it. We are SO CLOSE to being able to show the Democrats that we are READY for them in 2024. After the results of the recent elections -- we need this boost more than ever.

I'm letting you know how close we are to reaching our goal. In fact -- we are only $250 away...

We can't step off the gas so close to the finish line. **[If you and nine other patriots contributed $25, we could make up lost ground and finish this deadline with a BANG.](http://links.grassleyworks.com/u/click?_t=65a7ce1d347445428d0d4f22dfbcf47b&_m=048db033caca4653bf452b9778180e87&_e=3p96SJFiAz1cRcHAW9jDF0AGDLhzrRNY5qGQD2LbdIc-I30Wwp6-rNB5aLqgErHSWGOBW0h7Qo_Avj-kiMCPNwGnstH-MQuJKRAyUcdxIMhfLWrYxoGOyGeNa7YJIynlid4so3AhRvNGVCl2iCz1xF-a-igbUzdRpIsV307AzlXl-TAVauC8hkZQlOKH_9Z0ptaXTBhU1HquN8vQoKrztonj2nKAy3uUVweIt_7G-Je4xsL1iPSmqqf3zW6KXFRj2F66agR8UE9zT3nCH6ZvaAQd4KkUqbSakrpsJ8WN21k%3D)**

subject: A difficult decision

body:
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=766%2E791427%2EoAqdul)

Hey Friends -
Makenzie here, Ilhan's Finance Director. I'm reaching out because I made a difficult decision earlier this month.
It has become clear that in order to keep growing our coalition of supporters all across the country, we're going to need to scale up our investments in digital organizing and advertising.
The money wasn’t originally in our November advertising budget. But I gave the green light anyway.
It was a risk, there's no doubt about it. But right now our campaign must be doing everything we can to make sure Ilhan is prepared to take on a primary challenge and millions of dollars in outside spending.
So I made a bet that if I asked, you would help fill the gap. And I’m really hoping you will. For Ilhan. And for everyone who cares about Ilhan continuing to represent our movement in Congress.
**[Can you make a $3 contribution to Ilhan's campaign for Congress today? Every donation will help fill the budget gap we created making critical investments in this campaign.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-nov23.oBEWmx&refcode=em231128-1-NOR&t=2&akid=766%2E791427%2EoAqdul)
As I mentioned, this was a pretty tough call. But if there’s one thing that makes our campaign different than most, it’s the tens of thousands of people who have contributed so far this year to stand with Ilhan.
Thanks for chipping in today if you can afford it.
Makenzie Richardson
Ilhan for Congress

Hi there, Friend.

It's Speaker Mike Johnson.

You probably hadn't heard much about me until just a few weeks ago. Since then, no doubt you've heard a lot about me- some of it true, most of it lies whipped up by the fake news media.

_**In any case, let me take this opportunity to formally introduce myself.**_

I was born and raised in Shreveport, LA, where I learned to be a humble servant of God from a young age.

Before being elected to Congress in 2016, I spent nearly two decades as a Constitutional lawyer, where I was a leading defender of the right to life, religious liberty, free speech, free market principles, the word of God, and our great Constitution.

I am, and continue to be, proud of all the work I have done to defend traditional values and preserve the American way of life up until this point. **But more than anything else in my life, I am a proud father to my four beautiful children and a loving husband to my wife, Kelly. **

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=862%2E135344%2EciIXuy)

Hey there --
We're sure you didn't wake up this morning, spring out of bed and scream "Today is the day I am going to donate to help Elissa Slotkin hold Michigan's Senate seat for Democrats!"
But we’re emailing in the hope that you will consider contributing today anyway. Here’s why:
Michigan is going to be one of the closest, most competitive and expensive Senate races in the country next year. Recent polling shows a dead-heat in both the Senate and the Presidential races, which means we have two competitive elections to win next year. And now there are three serious potential Republican opponents in the race who both support federal abortion bans with no exceptions for rape or incest.
This news makes it especially important that we’re doing the work to build an early foundation now. Donations a year from now – when we’re in the home stretch – are important. But donations now are even more important, because they allow us to map out a strategic plan and make decisions about when and how we reach voters.
**We also hope you will contribute because the latest FEC filings show that Republican mega-donors like the DeVos family are going to throw everything they can at this race to flip Michigan red.** One of Elissa’s potential opponents, former Congressman Mike Rogers, received $46,200 from the DeVos’ – all made on a single day.
By contrast, the majority of the donations we receive come from people contributing significantly smaller donations than the DeVos family made to Mike Rogers: Our average email donation was $26 last quarter.
[**So while contributing to Elissa’s campaign for Senate might not have been at the top of your to-do list this morning, we would love it if you would consider donating $3 or whatever you can today. The amount is important, but not as important as the donation itself. It will add up fast when we're all chipping in.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-nov23.RK33_Y&refcode=em231129-2-tt&t=2&akid=862%2E135344%2EciIXuy)

Fellow American,

It probably comes as no surprise to you that the last month has been a blur. Everything transpired so quickly that my own family wasn’t even able to make it to Washington, D.C. to watch me be sworn in as the 56th Speaker of the House.

My team and I – which has grown exponentially in the last month – really have been burning the midnight oil, working around the clock to ensure the people’s House remains OPEN FOR BUSINESS.

In the past month,

1. I’ve sifted through hundreds of resumes.
2. Met with the leaders from the Pentagon, the Senate, and the executive branch.
3. Sat for interviews with Sean Hannity and Larry Kudlow, among others.
4. Met with the campaign staff at the National Republican Congressional Committee to set finance goals for the upcoming year.

I’ve got to be honest with you – with so many competing priorities, [**it’s critical to have the _best_ team by my side.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=94d52695dd304f77acae11f38ad57fea&_e=yJR7h3rHzUMXo5_hjw6f4cdgLEgPneME36YZdUakaDQiOVQrlwbANKc2ooJjtRDKNdBkuXfoe-lFMR6zIbvVdmXVhncAAACs1T6wdbFQVXg8yfED8xlflsOhwZhonDEt7HR_F6FxgaQQYl1nl48hKbGBwUD5R_TqFZGJPEV5FdrFdiMADW6PUrg8Xjky9eU3XVayyaKeK3QPsxnV608rtWMxdZDjFx1fjttGexwy7j1-qtx5aQd3q9Rb7WWDkn0tVuyqDBX8ZFd8k6sW2_jAd2ZBuKT3SY06tZY7rcW652lkNQLMobVAFOSthejJDnhvONbW6oNhncOWm6XQnABL191RnZ0yOa0WXOmra6e8iUGA2rrM3rTaX-vbHxwY_hZjD7P_74qVB2CuYEZjZ3ecbYRsX9-mHLvV7VJF4AfpWzg%3D) I’m working to continue filling positions as fast as possible while fulfilling my duties outside of the Capitol.

You see, aside from my official duties as Speaker, [**one of my new responsibilities is to be the chief fundraiser for the Republican Party.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=94d52695dd304f77acae11f38ad57fea&_e=yJR7h3rHzUMXo5_hjw6f4cdgLEgPneME36YZdUakaDQiOVQrlwbANKc2ooJjtRDKNdBkuXfoe-lFMR6zIbvVdmXVhncAAACs1T6wdbFQVXg8yfED8xlflsOhwZhonDEt7HR_F6FxgaQQYl1nl48hKbGBwUD5R_TqFZGJPEV5FdrFdiMADW6PUrg8Xjky9eU3XVayyaKeK3QPsxnV608rtWMxdZDjFx1fjttGexwy7j1-qtx5aQd3q9Rb7WWDkn0t0ZqayHxvVl4n6b6P-iwBXQy95eIhhad8irAXDxuG9feOX8vqPRBAr5k3ROhkjNB-jYC-04lDVY-YZruftYVj2NbnvnkoXxnmnEI5Mb8vHpbyRLvAK4FzneilXbQxpTIsg6JFZg-8p347wsRWkcthOTflAJnqp75gKnw6HOw3ZFE%3D) That means using this platform to raise money every single day of the year, so we have the necessary funds to defend our five-seat majority in next year’s election.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: This is a perfect reminder that “radical” plans CAN happen
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Many people said this would never happen.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1840%2E4032634%2E5dn6vy)
---
The first bill I introduced when I got to the Senate in 2013 was to make student loans more affordable so that Americans would not continue to get crushed by debt. And shortly after I launched my campaign for president, one of the first plans I released was to cancel student debt and ensure free technical schools, community colleges, and public universities. Across the country, in selfie line after selfie line, I heard stories from so many people — with tears in their eyes — explaining how much debt they were in, and how much this plan would mean for them. Another thing I kept hearing, though, over and over and over, was “Great idea, but that will never happen.” Well, this week, 813,000 borrowers received an email from President Biden with the words “Congratulations — your student loan has been forgiven.” This is a perfect reminder that “radical” plans CAN happen, when we fight for them. We got organized and got a broad-based student debt cancellation plan to the president’s desk. Even though the Supreme Court substituted politics for the rule of law by striking it down, we’re still persisting, and President Biden has still been able to cancel around $127 billion in student debt so far for nearly 3.6 million borrowers. I’m staying in the fight to lift this crushing burden from more people’s shoulders. **We can keep proving the naysayers wrong. We can keep showing what it looks like to make our government work for everyone, not just the wealthy and well-connected. It doesn’t all happen overnight, but it gets done because we fought side by side as a grassroots movement.** [**We can continue making big, structural change like this. We can make a wealth tax, universal child care, Supreme Court reform, and so much more possible. We just need to build our momentum, organize, and keep fighting side by side. So before our November fundraising deadline, can you pitch in $28 or anything you can to hit our goal and power our movement forward?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/993?amount=28&t=8&akid=1840%2E4032634%2E5dn6vy)

---
| [OTHER AMOUNT](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/993?t=20&express_lane=true&akid=1840%2E4032634%2E5dn6vy)
---

---
Once you start talking about helping working people instead of powerful special interests or ultra-wealthy corporations, plenty of critics will be quick to tell you what you can’t do and what’s not possible. But these ideas are popular. In a democracy, that matters. And the more change we make, the more momentum we build — by showing we can use the power of government to transform people’s lives. We need to keep laying out bold plans, and here’s the absolutely critical part: We need to be willing to fight for them. **I’m going to keep fighting with everything I’ve got — but nobody gets this done on their own.** [**That’s why I’m asking if you can pitch in to keep growing our movement and support our re-election campaign. If it makes sense for you right now, please make a donation before our end-of-month deadline tomorrow.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/993?t=14&akid=1840%2E4032634%2E5dn6vy) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

body:

Team, these days, I keep finding myself saying this: _Rick Scott is a fraud._
He calls himself a public servant, but he's shown us time and time again that, in reality, _he only serves himself_. He's pushed an extreme agenda that hurts working families**** all while he saw his own net worth **_nearly triple_** as governor of Florida.
He claims to be an advocate for families and seniors, but **he wrote the plan to end Social Security and Medicare** — lifesaving programs that millions of Americans, including my mom, rely on.
**Rick Scott is a liar**. He pushed Donald Trump's Big Lie about the 2020 election, voted to overturn the 2020 election, falsely claimed that mail-in voting wasn't secure, and spread misinformation about Democrats like me.
As if that's not enough, **he actually oversaw one of the largest Medicare fraud schemes in our nation's HISTORY.** He made millions defrauding American taxpayers (a fortune that he later used to buy his way into the Senate).
**One of Rick Scott's latest frauds is trying to convince people that Floridians are all in on his extremist agenda.** That's a lie, through and through. In his last election, my opponent only won by 10,033 votes. The fact is, Floridians are ready for a change.
**I promise to always tell the truth about my story, my record, my beliefs, my state, and what I'll fight for in Washington. That's why my campaign is already polling 1 point ahead — and it's why I know we're going to end Rick Scott's decades-long grift next November. #
Our November fundraising deadline is tomorrow, Peter.
In a moment, I’m going to ask you to **[add $5 toward our goal of raising 12,000 individual donations before December 1st.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/39482?refcode=em20231129-4285&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4285%2E614464%2EOJqWbV) But first, here are five reasons why your support for Lucas Kunce _right now_ is so critical:**
**[CHIP IN NOW →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/39482?refcode=em20231129-4285&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4285%2E614464%2EOJqWbV)**

2. **National Republicans have made this race their top defensive target in 2024.** These insiders know that if they don’t step in to tear down Lucas and make Josh Hawley look strong, there’s a real chance they could lose this Senate seat. So from launching desperate attacks to a new mega-donor-funded Super PAC, they’re already hard at work to keep this seat under their thumb.
3. **After major wins for red state Democrats and abortion rights in Kentucky and Ohio, we have an opportunity to make Missouri next.** Over the last three election cycles, Missouri voters have broken with politicians like Hawley to reject anti-union “Right-to-Work,” raise the minimum wage, expand Medicaid, and legalize weed. So in 2024, we really can defeat Josh Hawley.
4. **Lucas Kunce has proved that he can harness that grassroots energy.** First, he outraised Hawley in the first six months of 2023. Then, he earned the support of the Missouri AFL-CIO, local and statewide leaders, major national organizations like League of Conservation Voters, and tens of thousands of everyday working people who are ready to take back their power from corrupt politicians.
5. **Multiple recent polls show Lucas Kunce in a _statistical tie_ with Josh Hawley.** After working hard to hold Hawley accountable this year, Lucas has put this race in a dead heat. This is the clearest sign yet that we really can flip this seat.

**But now, we’ve got to keep this momentum going.** Hitting tomorrow’s deadline means we’ll have the ability to keep getting Lucas’ election-winning message in front of Missouri voters and stay on track to start 2024 off strong.
**[So Peter, will you add $5 (or more!) toward our goal of raising 12,000 individual donations before midnight tomorrow? Over the last three election cycles, Missouri voters have broken with politicians like Hawley to reject anti-union “Right-to-Work,” raise the minimum wage, expand Medicaid, and legalize weed. So in 2024, we really can defeat Josh Hawley. 4. Lucas Kunce has proved that he can harness that grassroots energy. First, he outraised Hawley in the first six months of 2023. Then, he earned the support of the Missouri AFL-CIO, local and statewide leaders, major national organizations like League of Conservation Voters, and tens of thousands of everyday working people who are ready to take back their power from corrupt politicians. 5. Multiple recent polls show Lucas Kunce in a statistical tie with Josh Hawley. After working hard to hold Hawley accountable this year, Lucas has put this race in a dead heat. This is the clearest sign yet that we really can flip this seat. But now, we’ve got to keep this momentum going. Hitting tomorrow’s deadline means we’ll have the ability to keep getting Lucas’ election-winning message in front of Missouri voters and stay on track to start 2024 off strong. Dear Friend,
As Americans, we cannot continue to accept the bare minimum from our elected officials. We cannot continue to applaud short term measures that only keep government functioning at a basic level. We cannot allow dysfunction in Congress to lower our expectations of those who represent us.
If you want more from your government. If you believe that the U.S. House of Representatives should be capable of setting policy that addresses big issues and that builds a brighter future for our country, I am asking you to make a donation to our campaign before midnight on November 30th. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
I’m currently serving my third term on City Council. I didn’t run for elected office to do the bare minimum, I did it because I wanted to help build a brighter future for my community. I know that governing usually isn’t exciting. It’s hard work. That hard work is what lays the foundation for accomplishing bigger things.
Those big things are what we should expect from our elected officials. I’m running for Congress because I know how to make government work. My colleagues and I do it every day. For us, failure isn’t an option. We do the hard work because our constituents are counting on us, and because we know that the basic functioning of government is the foundation that allows us pursue policies that address bigger issues and make life better for the people we represent.
If you’re sick and tired of lowering your expectations for the dysfunctional Republican Caucus, I am asking you to make a contribution to our campaign today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
With Gratitude,
Shamaine

I've seen time and time again how small acts have the power to create big, transformative change. And that's exactly how we're going to win this campaign next November.

| Peter, I'm about to ask you to help me hit my $150,000 end-of-month goal. But first, I want to tell you a story about doughnuts — and how they're going to help us save our Senate majority.

[_**(If you're short on time and ready to retire Rick Scott next fall, you can split a donation between my campaign and Fight for Progress to help me make up this fundraising gap and flip Florida blue.)**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/74270118/441128948/-225452087?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2023-11-29_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQ5ODI1OWVkLTFiOGYtZWUxMS04OTI1LTAwMjI0ODIyM2NiYSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=-B_aGy-zg2lLmsw8SR9MwrfYpNr0hAPapUetKrWpNZc=)

When I was 14, my family came to America to seek a better life. We arrived here with big dreams for the future. But those early days were hard. I remember my mom working back-to-back double shifts and still struggling to afford rent for our small, one-room apartment.

**So, after I turned 15, I got a job working the early morning shift at a local doughnut shop.** It was just a minimum wage job, but the small checks I brought home gave my family room to breathe. Finally, after a lot of hard work, the possibilities that we could only dream of before became reality.

We were able to move out of that one-room apartment, and I got a scholarship to an incredible college. Eventually, I found a career path where I could give back to the communities and country that gave me so much. That call to service took me to places I had never even dreamed of before. **I became the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and now, I'm running for the United States Senate.**

**Making doughnuts in the morning before homeroom brought me all the way to Congress. I've seen time and time again how small acts have the power to create big, transformative change. _And that's exactly how we're going to win this campaign next November._**

[_**That's why I'm asking you to split $10 — about the cost of a dozen doughnuts — between my campaign and Fight for Progress to send me to the Senate. Can you chip in before my end-of-month deadline to help me defeat Rick Scott? Fellow American,

It probably comes as no surprise to you that the last month has been a blur. Everything transpired so quickly that my own family wasn’t even able to make it to Washington, D.C. to watch me be sworn in as the 56th Speaker of the House.

My team and I – which has grown exponentially in the last month – really have been burning the midnight oil, working around the clock to ensure the people’s House remains OPEN FOR BUSINESS.

In the past month,

1. I’ve sifted through hundreds of resumes.
2. Met with the leaders from the Pentagon, the Senate, and the executive branch.
3. Sat for interviews with Sean Hannity and Larry Kudlow, among others.
4. Met with the campaign staff at the National Republican Congressional Committee to set finance goals for the upcoming year.

I’ve got to be honest with you – with so many competing priorities, [**it’s critical to have the _best_ team by my side.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=4f61d23c76b44a61bf22f4fb51bbd8c4&_e=XaDa6oVzNW4OQZL4vyPtgYaPLwlBJ1s9gJFAGTN4JSFcKkLHkzkl2UVmsKfrFqXsGKcq4OwkvWWtssQ8fCxL3Z-7fXaEAj7xag3V5FzsRNb8uR0rbxYvxs3kTpZZs8LL33AIPTdQUJpsnVxueRqPSgLHBGYUKKwA1Kz_o6H4Ng0yTB0YRwcUgPGASgKA8cg3WtxO4-KsdBYU4HDzYprgglBrLytVvvVXUEFuz4Hyb08_99uwnOYONoXc2WCra_SBmAcQn6690gvacpjgPkqe6m8qYfRyzI81E-1_LHXv0pV0OiS0yEbh_7weZ_z9nrY8MT7oBBczol1SrM1_GMsj985nIsvx7u-VL7ZKG_9HJRUo_YelP02D-dxeGugh_ZlPWxWHumgabk-qLvx6ZTJhBQ%3D%3D) I’m working to continue filling positions as fast as possible while fulfilling my duties outside of the Capitol.

You see, aside from my official duties as Speaker, [**one of my new responsibilities is to be the chief fundraiser for the Republican Party.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=4f61d23c76b44a61bf22f4fb51bbd8c4&_e=XaDa6oVzNW4OQZL4vyPtgYaPLwlBJ1s9gJFAGTN4JSFcKkLHkzkl2UVmsKfrFqXsGKcq4OwkvWWtssQ8fCxL3Z-7fXaEAj7xag3V5FzsRNb8uR0rbxYvxs3kTpZZs8LL33AIPTdQUJpsnVxueRqPSgLHBGYUKKwA1Kz_o6H4Ng0yTB0YRwcUgPGASgKA8cg3WtxO4-KsdBYU4HDzYprgglBrLytVvvVXUEFuz4Hyb08_99uwnOYONoXc2WCra_SBm7bIShswy2D5Jr0J0jFa3VeigqGgubUJwNMwBUH3ZnlHWxftA6P685Dv2Ean9nQDyTtYlpLhf_mw8Cfub_FssFRw8siFdVILaefcx2VxGh1SRGGo3qwdoGKbjs5hJ7vqJWxnRHFLVJrxrbmSHyquJQ%3D%3D) That means using this platform to raise money every single day of the year, so we have the necessary funds to defend our five-seat majority in next year’s election.

[**My staff has told me that we’re just short of having raised $2 million online since I was elected Speaker last month. body:
I’ve been traveling the state connecting with Californians from all walks of life
Hi Derek,
I wanted to provide a quick update, now that we’re less than 100(!) days to our primary election.
I’ve been traveling the state connecting with Californians from all walks of life. >From visiting with street vendors in LA, to talking with farm workers in the Central Valley, to meet and greets in San Francisco and Santa Cruz. I LOVE campaigning and hearing from Californians, and grassroots support has made all of these events possible.
**We’ve also been able to run digital ads ([you can check out our first ad here](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231129-2?refcode=EMAN23_2_iphone_20231129_V1_F&refcode2=33957_3422442_fCvJCy&akid=33957%2E3422442%2EfCvJCy)),** which are an effective and efficient way to reach the millions of undecided California voters who will decide this race.
But now, things are about to really heat up. We’re filming our first TV ad soon, and finalizing our digital and TV ad buys. Buying ad time in California is not cheap, in fact it’s 13x more expensive in parts of California than in other parts of the country.
I’m doing my best to stretch every dollar further, **but polling shows us a third of voters are undecided about who they’ll support.** That means we must do serious work to show voters what I’m all about, and why I’m the best candidate for the job.
Ahead of our November fundraising deadline, I’m wondering if you could make your first donation to our Senate campaign. I’d be so grateful to earn your support. Because I don’t take corporate PAC or federal lobbyist money, your contributions truly are what power this campaign. Here’s a personal link you can use: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231129-2?personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231129-2?refcode=EMAN23_2_iphone_20231129_V1_F&refcode2=33957_3422442_fCvJCy&akid=33957%2E3422442%2EfCvJCy)
Thanks so much,
Katie Porter

When I launched my campaign for president, I was seen as an underdog. I was underestimated time and time again - **but now, the tide is turning.**

Our momentum has never been higher.

I surged to be tied for _**SECOND**_ in Iowa.

I rose to _**SECOND**_ in New Hampshire.

I rose to _**SECOND** _in South Carolina.

I am **CRUSHING** Joe Biden in the national polls.

**And, I was declared the WINNER of the third presidential debate!**

_We are**RISING** to the top, and it's all thanks to people like you who have stepped up and supported my campaign._

While this is all great news, we've got to continue to keep our heads down, work hard, and earn every vote in order to win.

That's why I need your help today.**[Will you chip in $20.24 right now to help me fund my campaign and spread my message far and wide?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z2qjn5u7cif3gaqbb9sdfsh83v4vdbc8q2ipeu3o_rp22sh2s8i6eo34cpgm4o35cth2bs "Will you chip in $20.24 right now to help me fund my campaign and spread my message far and wide?")**

---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zgbjcmnrhqm10vdl70u1r62rus68h71894sibmno_rp22sh2s8i6eo34cpgm4o35cth2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: I want to know your thoughts
body:
There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried

|
---
| | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z65pdohegguuha7mc8abhtstiotjsu4v6apsthd8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34cpgm4o33c5h2bs)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zlcif8bibdocer719amh3a1a87goubf93qhgc5k8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34cpgm4o33c5h2bs) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z1io9c5aptthf5bs8pbji33t3fki8hvoa8c089b8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34cpgm4o33c5h2bs)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zms22lj5imeb2795aqkot4vhmkr5clhrq8in6sc0_rp22sh2s8i6eo34cpgm4o33c5h2bs)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: I want to know your thoughts
body:
There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried

|
---
| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z1acl70tg2572snq7qf1r9k6bt4p3ctlja3l5548_rp22sh2s8i6eo34cpgmaor7cdh2bs)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0u6esn776l9matma5fqg5dgfv87iou7vn5pec38_rp22sh2s8i6eo34cpgmaor7cdh2bs) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8cvpp0d67m16en4vfvrasp9b1pq19jrkgpcr2sg_rp22sh2s8i6eo34cpgmaor7cdh2bs)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5robqbk2ibdlh4s4jv54dbmeoqjpuaagmu0kub0_rp22sh2s8i6eo34cpgmaor7cdh2bs)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: I want to know your thoughts
body:
There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried

|
---
| | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c36218%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Ub8M9ThbODnQiMufrEEjhw&sysid=1)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c36219%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=VL5X%2fkdFUASV3S9aRjN1rA&sysid=1) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c36210%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=x8bEH6OrP5LLHDHi8s%2bZzQ&sysid=1)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c36211%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Z4B9XDkWN9Igx66ZlmSX2w&sysid=1)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

# Abortion in Nevada
Pro-Choice and Supporting Mark Robertson for U.S. Congress in Nevada D-1 By Beth Weddle, Communications Director, Robertson for U.S. Congress
---
When I met Mark Robertson three years ago, I was a 22-year resident of Nevada and a registered Independent. I re-registered as a Republican to back Mark in the 2022 Primary election. I have been firmly Pro-Choice since the '70s, believing the decision whether to have an abortion is made between a woman and her doctor. However, like most women, I have struggled with the viability issue, particularly at what point a pregnancy is too far before an abortion can be reasonably legislated. Or even if it can be legislated. According to all the polls, the vast majority of Americans oppose allowing full-term abortions. Democrats, including Titus, have indeed gone too far by supporting third-trimester partial-birth abortions and wanting to enshrine that in the Nevada Constitution. I am not going to explain what a partial-birth abortion is here because it so upsetting. Suffice it to say it is infanticide and frankly, murder. I urge you to take the time to do an internet search of exactly what a partial-birth abortion is. Or reply to this message, and I will send you the definition. It is beyond belief that Democrats are supporting such an initiative. Having said that, let's look at what Mark says on the abortion issue and why I can support him rather than his opponent, Dina Titus. Mark supports the Supreme Court's decision in 2022 to overturn Roe v. Wade because he believes it is the correct legal decision. It is consistent in protecting the reasonable abortion rights in Nevad, which has been our state law for more than 30 years. Mark has said: "Nevada does have a statute giving women the right to an abortion. In fact, it was passed by a referendum of the people. This means the Governor or the legislature cannot overturn the law. Only the people of Nevada can change it. Nevada is a pro-choice State." Mark will not support any federal legislation on abortion that goes against the will of the people of Nevada, and I trust him on that. Take the time to investigate exactly the evil that partial-birth abortion is. Understand why Titus stammers like Porky Pig when challenged to explain and defend it. Then, join me in voting for Mark Robertson for U.S. Congress in Nevada's First Congressional District. Beth Weddle is the Communications Director for the Robertson For Congress Campaign. She volunteers her time, talents, and support to the campaign. She believes we need a person of honor and integrity to represent us in Congress.

| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1b06386ad2624e0e997b870eda4972d0&_e=JS4de0QsN5GAe2IyFdJnug55cFfdr5qWQIEL0-9Hz_DwAgCQFKfzs92QQvKPN1IrzM2pfxiBavEP_WkJcbrG4OYprwp5HDnaZ6UcHrcxOh3JHnVJvsn4_Gf4Pre8q778IRO6rtFz9OJLH5arr7A23QsfqIlfKdqeoVY2MlHJi2brzi_z9lITLVFP8Uzgm1_dt8N_mYpjVtNuhPkfn0f1J0kvC1BdjtK4DeYwIBMOT-Mx97ZcuSEbDQoCpw7WtXvwfzDncL57fOW0AKn0-2T_-__5qulBZUnrZrMWhjoaCpiW_JxgUlZgi8RDZan5ehbUz569lTgPd3GF0IrXAW1tmbJ4eZswRtJKoV_I_zMKi3SwlxO93mdqMKQ01IlFEUezVt37YLwpxyy7YC59KtOWxGilBMWuOKViFqMmgyaE4k0%3D)

Dear Friend,

Charles Dickens, a very great novelist, had a special gift for revealing important truths in delightful ways through unforgettable characters.

To mark this holiday season, Hillsdale College is releasing a new online course on what is perhaps Dickens' most beloved novel: _A Christmas Carol_.

The course is taught by the excellent Dwight Lindley, an English professor here at Hillsdale who loves both reading Dickens and teaching Dickens.

In this six-lecture course, Dwight will help you understand more fully the causes of Ebenezer Scrooge's conversion in the novel and what the story teaches us about leading a happy and complete life.

You can use the secure link below to begin experiencing the wisdom and fun of _A Christmas Carol_ today.

**[https://online.hillsdale.edu/prereg/christmas-carol](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4faf1290c1a84238ba22f970f849e75f&_e=y1VjTdYLYTAaLVI5gc7Alh7ApIAx5_G8Xx75lEskMuAQrXO9naPt7uYU_wOyKrkrQ4t4zY260UwmkhluEfmU_eYwYeLqJ5RUtUnwgC-9CsjirtYcgFQZB7NeKBOtmaxzjKmkiuPyTOKqEq2Z-PnuipACpbrenZd0Oveh5hXM55i8QBxbHlTXN6xpDwSMHqrdst8y6QOAiXMnYccOQxuf8oY-fUureNYW_TZLlrPQcs68baTQBGe_IOJSmNJCGoNGiXQov5G6jf93AAhUK_cGgw_xU-HVCYGJZXVc8P9MUKDdIflVQ3dgAypFyn6m7G0UubB5EdmK_J9Ab9auBAQpnDwFTxdlYnQrkc6HfTK2-v_pb7EdWQ9UeQKgsVycWYrVMFqkj6mv737QPUMZUHFH6g%3D%3D)**

## Henry Kissinger Dead at 100
Henry Kissinger [died yesterday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0Ltu7CAUheGnwR0WtwG7oDiNuzltSouBjb0TDBagsebto0mVIt2Svmbp_7ivd4cJ8_bfHWB7LKvzHZ-wck4lo0Kuagg2AgiQA1huGJc3Matp2C1_mDgH42OM2gUjvJ6ikso4EZie9DygFUxIziXj7DYrPTKIejYzCzfgMmpJFIOAvdTxs2DuO8T0Kk-ooy_HkOze-9mI_EfEQsRyXdeYHz7D1d5OxHKWhB19-zXpm4lYdsj1Rb-wNcwbVHqVmgJtuzsxbzTgmcrhOg0IjXLGaPXZcWEkV0O14bwwJWzaEMW2w2H6OdT_7vMdAAD__yPXaDc) at his home in Connecticut. Born in Germany, he fled the Nazis with his family and arrived in America in 1938. After serving in the U.S. military during WW2 and completing his education at Harvard, he became an [extremely influential diplomat](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1ywyAQBOCnQR2a49BPVFCkUee0KTUYTtYlCDyArfHbZ-Q67W7z7X5flovlwPH2ZXcydU2LdZWftCglNUjUS9d4sxIh6YaMGkHpHqfuo9mMHR0SwnVQbnJKj1f0U7-Cs9qqjhAbNgioldKgoJ-6oQVah2mcwPek9Dpo0QF5rim3P4lj3WgNr_Sk3Lq0N8Fstd6L0J8CZ4HzcRxtpkelXM7-TFIOXuD8KALnjWJ-yV8uheONsrQ7ZXY2Ss_3kHZbZUxXCvLgGClLT9ZLBSBPonyvFTg32fj7wSFwGUbRwW23HN6a-v85fwEAAP__KwhlDA), serving as national security advisor to President Nixon and winning the Nobel Peace Prize for negotiating the Paris Peace Accords. Later, he became Secretary of State, an office [he maintained](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LtuxCAQheGngY7VAONbQZHG3aZNaWEY25NgY2G00b59lFXKVKf4iiP9H_fp7jnxsb77nVxd8uRD5QdNWisLytgJZXQLkSEryekOtG3MgL3cXGyw78gH6GmeTTPEMCBC37XBYxsAJTsDxmptQUMzYHsDWtqhGyA2pO3SWoFAkWsut8_MR91oSc_8oHILeZfJbbWel7BvwozCjHWjjVP6NWHGOeX1-ls1F6aFj1WV_EK0FhvUyu9UOPhDRT5T3n1VGx3lqb74uvhYqajIdClflQYQZpTFxfObU-Kr7QTCunt-Hcr6f5ufAAAA__9yHGTu) in the Ford administration. Kissinger played a major role in improving America's relationships with China and the Soviet Union, along with a host of other diplomatic endeavors. He's survived by his wife and two children.

As we close out this month, we are confronted with a stark reality: we are - once again - behind on our monthly fundraising goal.

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: What are your thoughts?
body:
After the Respect for Marriage Act was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law

|
---
| | | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2d6e657950a8474db6669fde9df2e730&_e=3ZLwlP2vA3tqcjdc_qmGtATGeuZzvxtwe0fUzrGLVdMSYY_R1EdWLYoqocYPaLvhqbRzMWAhnTylQPUHutUj-jx_FrnlT6ycB7dsk1T6L90cOiawnHV2Jp5LIRvQrVmsoDAhCByBpdUWA_28slbj-hX2AZylcRhH7uWs_6zj_96pgJGHj7ZsGjkBfy5FQY6B56wJ-5rtjbYI9QMRGbKrnuyFbo2N3usI2NKjeEob5zTTqPweYENKwLVDXgH5I88qjf_9CF6pJvEhJ5nDYzNSAOzT3eLs1mrESI6x4Vp1f3TdnCyFR6AghRYfCug01itviCTXoRhvMgdgwpGXYCUeHWVbp5DgO_fcwdWgRU2aIc38KTwvseVpJme8NVoIGefnxLzAMySVGHXIlJtqQZvRn2VkxdzgGBlPNULkn2AgTEw%3D)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2d6e657950a8474db6669fde9df2e730&_e=3ZLwlP2vA3tqcjdc_qmGtATGeuZzvxtwe0fUzrGLVdMSYY_R1EdWLYoqocYPaLvhqbRzMWAhnTylQPUHutUj-jx_FrnlT6ycB7dsk1T6L90cOiawnHV2Jp5LIRvQrVmsoDAhCByBpdUWA_28slbj-hX2AZylcRhH7uWs_6zj_96pgJGHj7ZsGjkBfy5FQY6B56wJ-5rtjbYI9QMRGbKrnuyFbo2N3usI2NKjeEob5zTTqPweYENKwLVDXgH5I88qjf_9CF6pJvEhJ5nDYzNSAHtcy2cVSVVc2mytPAjF9FKvugNVHo1AIeb5cI_9Qu0PQpjn2Hx6heyHQxmuTrh0FJKeJKWRY4yBRBiN-6ObAap5kd71rHKt9ipP1q7wnSqJk868wmjydUFHa85bAF04Jkt-FLBnYL5kdT1Ic1yUAbc%3D) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2d6e657950a8474db6669fde9df2e730&_e=3ZLwlP2vA3tqcjdc_qmGtATGeuZzvxtwe0fUzrGLVdMSYY_R1EdWLYoqocYPaLvhqbRzMWAhnTylQPUHutUj-jx_FrnlT6ycB7dsk1T6L90cOiawnHV2Jp5LIRvQrVmsoDAhCByBpdUWA_28slbj-hX2AZylcRhH7uWs_6zj_96pgJGHj7ZsGjkBfy5FQY6B56wJ-5rtjbYI9QMRGbKrnuyFbo2N3usI2NKjeEob5zTTqPweYENKwLVDXgH5I88qjf_9CF6pJvEhJ5nDYzNSAElTe4jkQZCo13qWj_4OsgVwb-t-ai5EQkXZukwEpTdVx_0boX7MIUi9I_61wiFpC1Lew_SEExO4Zh1MOl2ySpt6JTypYnk4E4EQ2UecRtRMsvw0ff7noYU5pkl1pav7UjkqkZdy9CztHvXengx1Yvw%3D)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2d6e657950a8474db6669fde9df2e730&_e=3ZLwlP2vA3tqcjdc_qmGtATGeuZzvxtwe0fUzrGLVdMSYY_R1EdWLYoqocYPaLvhqbRzMWAhnTylQPUHutUj-jx_FrnlT6ycB7dsk1T6L90cOiawnHV2Jp5LIRvQrVmsoDAhCByBpdUWA_28slbj-hX2AZylcRhH7uWs_6zj_96pgJGHj7ZsGjkBfy5FQY6B56wJ-5rtjbYI9QMRGbKrnuyFbo2N3usI2NKjeEob5zTTqPweYENKwLVDXgH5I88qjf_9CF6pJvEhJ5nDYzNSADoOMnzwXi6Jrvw6RPzhltRyQfIZbwdNhV-RbDM3vd037oEv-2YZgSjzKxGJtDQFGRSI8ykM-Ki_3JaeP9Rh3V4Uvroko27R8jy5nc3Ozw36Q1pFSs0262fl_3iL1E0O-56iENzQth2uIiEDL4J5f8Y%3D)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

Dear Friend,

Charles Dickens, a very great novelist, had a special gift for revealing important truths in delightful ways through unforgettable characters.

To mark this holiday season, Hillsdale College is releasing a new online course on what is perhaps Dickens' most beloved novel: _A Christmas Carol_.

The course is taught by the excellent Dwight Lindley, an English professor here at Hillsdale who loves both reading Dickens and teaching Dickens.

In this six-lecture course, Dwight will help you understand more fully the causes of Ebenezer Scrooge's conversion in the novel and what the story teaches us about leading a happy and complete life.

You can use the secure link below to begin experiencing the wisdom and fun of _A Christmas Carol_ today.

**[https://online.hillsdale.edu/prereg/christmas-carol](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=721c6447957246c7b2ac95b58021e984&_e=3HkulURgwf8U-hkPXePiVAvFrE5vvzY5sPlDHyhHMVSOrWwinYMQnmA7WD1VPbRp2NNgNh0A4SHoteNKe7MLrOzrt-tChuGGixdQNj2j0x7M6D0GhN8cnUZJDa0iFulWi7Yqgv0ZUrVtscLx8itMMnzNQeZShd4GtvzQkKbquaWyjo9SULQRC7ThAF6T48MQ2KKOjlQ40j2yMwU1vq5dHl5dmBt3ZICnibNn2lFZTbTgwb4YV7dcHcOaShYbSRy_-p8GiXCILirF0pEKRid6h1tG42MogKzmkvlzzB9uYdLIvk4remykhJKzxKmtqpb5sMuQugp1sZ45exBVaxxZrZylPiaQappIivQwN8_wLNS2UiTsqGdLa5stdsN2afzHFkIWeA-IjN0gvViU-HHGfg%3D%3D)**

Fellow American,

It probably comes as no surprise to you that the last month has been a blur. Everything transpired so quickly that my own family wasn't even able to make it to Washington, D.C. to watch me be sworn in as the 56th Speaker of the House.

My team and I - which has grown exponentially in the last month - really have been burning the midnight oil, working around the clock to ensure the people's House remains OPEN FOR BUSINESS.

In the past month,

1. I've sifted through hundreds of resumes.
2. Met with the leaders from the Pentagon, the Senate, and the executive branch.
3. Sat for interviews with Sean Hannity and Larry Kudlow, among others.
4. Met with the campaign staff at the National Republican Congressional Committee to set finance goals for the upcoming year.

I've got to be honest with you - with so many competing priorities, [**it 's critical to have the _best_ team by my side.**](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b7d6f2228a6945a494f0f33aadd020aa&_e=8LkYtWULCGmPOMTJud8-nL_yEmdfapfH2E7WA2dva4h3w33jJnRzYVmG0O62_L4pjxPN8PtPwwGaC_b44f4WNNoKvklKrc-kIjrIhtOlKxnt31WQctlehO72GjqQSBlb-v-HH2AR5EIeR-4WeYxLKEpd7pV9ytguz4xEfgPxNX-evHC4W24ppr-TW9pa7y3WHNiP8HlB8rzPs9xacp0ubbmLF5zfScrGANGiXeBbvqeXs-JtEIQcJ2R-q_GDYFdi4RUhp2Vs0cJutoRKh4lyZBgOBZRobkb5BgtNDHaxssq3kr39zUVS4TbMCHNsxuaEfldacoWgLAd363iCMJNsGNnL_RvABH8hIokb89w4mqjzv0_4ZKhHMqzKDTq3-rQRNgTXHDbEcOfPeCwiT2b6qsoNMzaBdgYGLvMpYU8tmTw%3D) I'm working to continue filling positions as fast as possible while fulfilling my duties outside of the Capitol.

You see, aside from my official duties as Speaker, [**one of my new responsibilities is to be the chief fundraiser for the Republican Party.**](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b7d6f2228a6945a494f0f33aadd020aa&_e=8LkYtWULCGmPOMTJud8-nL_yEmdfapfH2E7WA2dva4h3w33jJnRzYVmG0O62_L4pjxPN8PtPwwGaC_b44f4WNNoKvklKrc-kIjrIhtOlKxnt31WQctlehO72GjqQSBlb-v-HH2AR5EIeR-4WeYxLKEpd7pV9ytguz4xEfgPxNX-evHC4W24ppr-TW9pa7y3WHNiP8HlB8rzPs9xacp0ubbmLF5zfScrGANGiXeBbvqeXs-JtEIQcJ2R-q_GDYFdiTGXHtIuqF-xzoFo41PLDyQrpzH9RGpSkk0jYxkZm88R-2yyoKGnve5PFa1S9qPz4D85EQbOjX2n0h46K3uC_X9yAGHUajQD0Z8neXCQ1Kr4xVh-Jd7xdOde4AnyAJRIa_AodsPTnQoszlXRHS8-ofeRpTihoVJSc4f2f9Xm0DHM%3D) That means using this platform to raise money every single day of the year, so we have the necessary funds to defend our five-seat majority in next year's election.

[**My staff has told me that we 're just short of having raised $2 million online since I was elected Speaker last month. In fact, we have just another $500,000 to raise to hit that mark - and we need to do it before Saturday at 11:59 p.m.**](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b7d6f2228a6945a494f0f33aadd020aa&_e=8LkYtWULCGmPOMTJud8-nL_yEmdfapfH2E7WA2dva4h3w33jJnRzYVmG0O62_L4pjxPN8PtPwwGaC_b44f4WNNoKvklKrc-kIjrIhtOlKxnt31WQctlehO72GjqQSBlb-v-HH2AR5EIeR-4WeYxLKEpd7pV9ytguz4xEfgPxNX-evHC4W24ppr-TW9pa7y3WHNiP8HlB8rzPs9xacp0ubbmLF5zfScrGANGiXeBbvqeXs-JtEIQcJ2R-q_GDYFdik-dsSAV-1ZOmqopkIxScxApIo3ymvdMEDua1RFvh6dq2Ug-9icybZgmSqpgYPteSOkj7_PHJZPTmkJkElTAMqdApxYJF5sthn2kwlrNlBdbu7HyQzcVlLvlywdNIjtadCnpCbm651x7kPyhQ4lMhIErgciwiio9kIpF4ZEFsBqQ%3D)

Fellow American, The radical Left wants you to forget. They want you to forget how wrong they were about COVID. They want you to forget that they lied to your face for over a year. They want you to forget that they let extremists riot in the streets while they told you to skip holidays with your loved ones and to "social distance." They want you to forget how they closed our schools, our businesses, and our houses of worship. (Gavin Newsom even closed Orange County beaches). **And maybe most of all, they want you to forget that thousands of hardworking, competent people either lost their jobs or were forced to take a vaccine they didn 't want. ** **They want you to forget that ...** _... And I hope you never do._ Because if you forget what they did, it's only a matter of time before they do it again. It's only a matter of time before they find a new reason to trample your rights and your freedoms for the so-called "greater good." We can't forget what the radical Left and its draconian policies did to us and to our families - and we can't let them forget it either. **That 's why the Center for American Liberty is still putting their feet to the fire and holding them accountable.** But nothing we do is possible without the generosity of patriots like you. **[**Will you give us the funds we need to win this landmark case and make the Left pay for what it did?**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=fd131d60c1ab445bb7f0dd50d9383d2d&_e=jAGf2Y6J7Q6PQfoWB_axEmvrrcslXOZ8H_M2GA6EOD7pEsgzzH_KOqb1ui5-Q7YzXRI2VJFUYYhcEwpX03TjueIEousW0hkQaYfhsvbB45MuAcQFBK83Tev_6eazU9VYFF2Gd0z4MOIWNek6PSKM34QXpy_POX91xlCnQvovu2Vh1oLRYJxOsP4j7jCcRXY5FWzXc7BCvp7bNiF3q329LyVwagpiU1xYReXjeOvnPsPDp-d6TyVzRY1TFI5m3St6TYdERrd_it-5cXMXl1y0WJ2CdI74neRqK6eVA7q_4KaGJouBKt6njxEg8YSijNrgQlSDmkhyFrPVhMEEn9QojErsSbClkEqgJdK_-18qwFlyKcvPukV3-nJwXq8zjc-O)** We filed a lawsuit against the North Carolina Symphony on behalf of three musicians fired for refusing to get the COVID-19 vaccine. And if we can win this critical lawsuit, we can put employers across the country on notice ahead of what some are calling a COVID resurgence. Dovid was the assistant concertmaster and first violinist, while Chris and Rachel both played the French Horn. They are some of the most talented musicians in the country in highly coveted and competitive positions. _Each of them had been in the Symphony for over a decade._ When the Symphony introduced its vaccine mandate, it offered both religious and medical exemptions. Dovid, Chris and Rachel each hold sincere religious beliefs that prohibit them from taking the COVID vaccine. They all filed for religious exemptions and were willing to take other measures, like regularly testing, to prove they didn't have COVID. But shortly after submitting their requestions for religious exemptions, the Symphony rejected their requests and put them on UNPAID LEAVE. These three musicians were Buddhist, Christian and Jewish. **It doesn 't matter who you are or what you believe - the radical Left doesn't respect your right to practice your faith as you see fit.** In their eyes, your body doesn't belong to you - it belongs to them. I'm deciding to take a stand - and I hope you will too. **[**Please make a generous, tax-deductible donation to the Center for American Liberty to fund this lawsuit for religious freedom and set a precedent nationwide that puts these radicals on notice.**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=fd131d60c1ab445bb7f0dd50d9383d2d&_e=jAGf2Y6J7Q6PQfoWB_axEmvrrcslXOZ8H_M2GA6EOD7pEsgzzH_KOqb1ui5-Q7YzXRI2VJFUYYhcEwpX03TjueIEousW0hkQaYfhsvbB45MuAcQFBK83Tev_6eazU9VYFF2Gd0z4MOIWNek6PSKM34QXpy_POX91xlCnQvovu2Vh1oLRYJxOsP4j7jCcRXY5FWzXc7BCvp7bNiF3q329LwZaEAUPZDADuDfBJAsOK5kHm-92rxavd0qxLzxJqFHrAgFW6s_MZQMnRyuiu6LrNDtAXxbJqaUMjaR-wdhaA8KEpgZw9ck7HIEKOCv0BW4c0VxkfhT736pBOncgK1P19HM4lRHiXlgX9ISxnMHAWPEkI10-WpCuew1NNVIuhmyU)** Even after lifting its vaccine mandate, the Symphony refused to give these musicians their jobs back. Fellow American,

It probably comes as no surprise to you that the last month has been a blur. Everything transpired so quickly that my own family wasn't even able to make it to Washington, D.C. to watch me be sworn in as the 56th Speaker of the House.

My team and I - which has grown exponentially in the last month - really have been burning the midnight oil, working around the clock to ensure the people's House remains OPEN FOR BUSINESS.

In the past month,

1. I've sifted through hundreds of resumes.
2. Met with the leaders from the Pentagon, the Senate, and the executive branch.

| | _**_Meet Tom Cotton_**_

Tom Cotton was born and raised on his family's cattle farm in Arkansas, served as an Army infantry officer in Iraq and Afghanistan, and is fighting for working Americans in the U.S. Senate.

The tragic attacks of September 11, 2001 occurred during Tom's final year of law school and changed his life's trajectory.

After clerking on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit and spending a short time in private law practice, he joined the United States Army as an Infantry Officer, spending nearly five years on active duty.

Between his two combat tours he served as a platoon leader with the Old Guard at Arlington National Cemetery, the unit responsible for military honors funerals.

Tom's military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal, Combat Infantry Badge, and Ranger Tab.

In the U.S. Senate, he's fighting the tough battles for Arkansans and Americans, and delivering real results. He knows that only the strong can survive in a dangerous world, and he's building a movement to make America strong again.

**CLICK THE IMAGES BELOW TO LEARN MORE ABOUT EVENTS**
| | | | | | | | |
## Filing for Candidacy
_(Austin, Texas)_
I **officially filed my candidacy** for TX-8 at the Texas Democratic Party office in Austin and later checked in with Montgomery County Democratic Party Chair Ginger Blair at Conroe HQ. **The evolving population in TX-8, marked by growth and diversity, demands representation** —I aim to be that voice.
---
| [](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=36d22ec0fd&e=a2a46ff12c)
---
| | | | | | | | |
# Food Drive
_(Huntsville, Texas)_
It was an honor to volunteer at Mount Zion Missionary Baptist Church in Huntsville, TX, for their monthly food drive. The community's commitment to supporting each other is truly inspiring. A special thanks to Yolanda Scott, a community member and Huntsville city council candidate, for joining. Heartwarming to witness the community unite for a positive impact.
---
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=44c7b9c80d&e=a2a46ff12c)
|
## Katy Area Democrats
_(Katy, Texas)_
I had an amazing time at the Katy Area Democrats' Thanksgiving event! Had inspiring chats with local candidates and joined in donating canned goods for Katy Christian Ministries. We also spread joy by writing Thanksgiving cards for retirement communities. A day filled with community and giving back!
---
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=c048437ceb&e=a2a46ff12c)
| | | | | | | | |
## Community Center Sale
_(Coldspring, Texas)_
I volunteered at Coldspring's Community Center sale, backing this vital hub as a committed board member. Funds will renovate our 1955 building. As a candidate, I prioritize community involvement, working alongside fellow residents for impactful change. I am grateful for Coldspring's incredible community
---
| [](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=a8af43b1be&e=a2a46ff12c)
---
| | | | | | | | |
# CyTomball Democrats
_(Cypress, Texas)_
I had an incredible meeting with the CyTomball Democratic Club! Got to hear from inspiring 2024 candidates and the Harris County Democratic Party chair. The energy and enthusiasm were infectious—I'm truly excited about our commitment to making a positive change in our communities
---
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=4060309373&e=a2a46ff12c)
|
## Swearing-in Ceremony
_(Huntsville, Texas)_
I attended the swearing-in ceremony for Huntsville City Council's newly elected members. Congrats to my friend, Anissa Antwine, set to advocate remarkably for our community.
---
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=3d2d6df469&e=a2a46ff12c)
| | | | | | | | |
## Motown Christmas
## _(Houston, Texas)_

An incredible evening at the Ensemble Theatre in Houston for the opening night of Motown Christmas! The performers were stunningly talented, and the music was simply fantastic.
---
| [](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=1fe38842b0&e=a2a46ff12c)

[**Grassroots group shifts support from incumbent Rep. Bilirakis, endorses primary challenger James Judge**](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=c08195ecc4&e=00028e5542)
PASCO COUNTY, Fla. – [Community Patriots](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=315a022985&e=00028e5542), a conservative grassroots organization in the Tampa Bay area, endorsed James Judge in the Republican primary for Florida’s 12th Congressional District on Thursday.
The group, which in 2022 endorsed incumbent Rep. Gus Bilirakis (R-FL), decided to shift their support from the incumbent Republican, to the younger, more uniquely qualified opponent.
“James Judge is the right person to represent Republicans in Florida’s 12th Congressional District. He is a strong supporter of law enforcement and has demonstrated he will fight for conservative, Christian values,” said Jeff Hawks, founder of Community Patriots. “While we appreciate Gus’s service, he has been in public office for 25 years. It’s time for someone new. We feel James has his finger on the pulse of the critical issues facing Florida’s 12th Congressional District and the United States today, and that he is better qualified to represent the interests of conservatives in Washington.”
Community Patriots is an active conservative organization throughout the Tampa Bay area with more than 5,000 participants across Pasco, Hillsborough and Pinellas.

---
[](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=4132031c52&e=567664f14c)

We're excited to share the [latest episode](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=a77d59223a&e=567664f14c) of the No Doubt About It podcast with Mark and Krysty Ronchetti, featuring an exclusive and eye-opening chat with Paul Gessing of the Rio Grande Foundation.
[](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=f1150a34d2&e=567664f14c)
This episode is a must-listen for anyone curious about the future of electric vehicles (EVs) in our state. Paul Gessing doesn't hold back as he lays bare the threats posed by current policies and offers insights into potential pathways for improvement and growth.
A significant portion of our discussion centers around the dramatic push towards EVs in New Mexico, championed by Governor Lujan Grisham. We explore the brutal economic implications of this move, from environmental impacts to strain on the electricity grid, and the inexplicable damage faced by car dealers and consumers alike. We question the feasibility and potential negative ramifications of this potentially seismic shift in the state's automotive industry.
| [STREAM EPISODE 56 NOW](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=ee6af719f4&e=567664f14c)
---
Our genuine concern about the impact of the EV mandate on rural areas sparks a discussion on the obstacles faced by manufacturers in producing EVs at a profitable cost. The political landscape in New Mexico is also scrutinized through the lens of Governor Michelle Lujan Grisham's misguided policies.
| [STREAM EPISODE 56 NOW](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=a5f3ff2ed7&e=567664f14c)

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: difficult decisions.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
The team had to make a pretty difficult decision yesterday, and I thought you should know about it.
#

Hey there, Peter, it's Ruben again. This is one of the last times we’ll reach out before our deadline at midnight tonight.
The team had to make a pretty difficult decision this weekend, and I thought you should know about it.
It’s no secret that Kari Lake launched her campaign last month. She did it with the endorsement of the big guy: Trump himself. But this month, she’s started rallying some support in the Senate GOP. They even rolled out an attack ad against me right before Thanksgiving.
All this happened as our campaign donations started falling off. And today — our November deadline day — we’re well behind. That’s bad news.
Kari Lake, Trump, the Senate GOP, if any of them see weakness from us, they will pile on with everything they’ve got. Without getting into too much detail, there are a number of investments we have to make so we can stay in the fight.
We didn’t think we’d have to pull the trigger on those for a few months now, but our timeline needed to move up because of the attack ads coming our way.
So we gave the green light. We approved the budget. And now we have to pay for it.
This team has always shown up for me when the chips were down. And I’m telling you all this now because today is one of those days.
What that really means is... I need your help. Really. So please:
[**Can you make a $3 contribution to my campaign for Senate today? Every donation will help close our budget gap ahead of tonight’s end-of-month deadline.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-nov23.azuTO_&refcode=em231130-1-f&t=1&akid=1499%2E734936%2EIpac8J)
This was a difficult decision. But if there’s one thing that sets our campaign apart from all the others in this race, it’s you. You are keeping us in this fight.
Thanks for chipping in today if you can afford it.
And thanks for being in this fight,
Ruben

When Fitzpatrick voted for Jim Jordan twice and then Mike Johnson during the Republican Speakership fiasco, we weren’t surprised. **It's just another example of how Fitzpatrick is a MINO – Moderate In Name Only.** Because repeatedly voting for a Speaker who is loudly anti-choice, anti-democracy, anti-LGBTQ+, and anti-worker is as extreme as it gets. | Peter -
Especially now, you are surely hearing the repeated refrain from politicians that they are "fighting" for you.
But what does that phrase - "fighting for you" \- actually mean?
Too many believe that "fighting" means screaming the loudest on cable news. Too many believe that it means being overly provocative on social media. And too many, sadly, believe they are the real fighters for the conservative movement when their tactics set our movement up for failure.
That is not what fighting means.
Real fighting means fighting to win. It means working hard to understand the biggest challenges facing America and then crafting solutions to those challenges. It means articulating a governing philosophy and policy framework in a way that will persuade. It means engaging in the tedious, meticulous nature of lawmaking that will deliver lasting results for our country.
And it means building and sustaining conservative, governing majorities at every level of American politics so our policy solutions get passed into and remain law.
That's what real fighting means. And that's what I mean when I say I fight for you.

I'm fighting for you as chairman of the Congressional task force to combat the Mexican drug cartels, who continue to degrade our sovereignty and kill Americans with fentanyl.
As a Texan, I'm fighting to secure our southern border and stop the illegal immigration crisis Joe Biden has created.
I'm fighting to grow our conservative movement and elect strong conservative leaders to public office across our country.
That's how I'm fighting for you. [If you'd like to see me continue to fight for you in Congress, I would greatly appreciate your support.](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Rjg9fLRc5e3ngH1KuqvJlfhfFC7ZDcqSiqcyENmOBduV3VmD6xiQKm5R04pHYahSMzxvU47wcJkzATu6SF0CYMLT4mYdi7kY-RkEh4MrRIDBYR5EEsH2XucDXhB35s5a_twyHGHC6eYYwIzDTBiyJZEtNypXiVKRTm1pSoXOVMNsiailPcyF5qF7WCAei_yQ3mPigek7ulA=&c=uXRsefB8MlbyZ-30znzFAcbQktIGunPdmEhd2dNR5i4Y1Gj5oNnaQQ==&ch=xKfB-hyCqSMflmwEL3k5_-bf_U2bsmwcJzo7n9ON2dop31z_sxBh7w==)

| More about Russell Prescott: A New Hampshire native of the Seacoast, Russell Prescott grew up in Exeter and currently lives in Kingston. For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.
He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business.

It’s important. [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] Friend — [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
I’m writing to you today because I am proud to endorse Debbie Mucarsel-Powell for U.S. Senate in Florida.
I love Florida, and am proud to call it home — but our state has been victim to some of the worst mass shootings in our country. Florida families, including mine, have been shattered by shootings in Parkland, Fort Lauderdale, and Orlando.
I know from personal experience that Florida desperately needs a leader in the United States Senate who cares about public safety and fiercely defends the right of every Floridian to live free of gun violence. Debbie Murcasel-Powell is that leader. Meanwhile, as a Senator, Rick Scott has sided with the gun lobby every time.
Debbie is up against a man who bought this Senate seat for himself last time round — and still only won by less than 1%! I hope you’ll join me in supporting Debbie Mucarsel-Powell for Senate by splitting a gift between her campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand — with grassroots support, I know she can deliver the leadership Florida deserves.
CHIP IN NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_dmp?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5]
Thank you for being in this fight. I know Debbie, and I know we can build a brighter future for Florida.
Fred Guttenberg

body:
Democrats in Central Washington Roar!
| | **Can't see this message?_[View in a browser](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/4aOlJc2B4/c?w=nSyIRKApxkcuTjUn7XaXewbMMCWaHN7nSiGIxpGIBQw.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucnVyYWxhbWVyaWNhbnN1bml0ZWQub3JnL3NvLzRhT2xKYzJCND9sYW5ndWFnZVRhZz1lbiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9)_**

| |
---
| | Occasionally our newsletter focuses on our accomplishments and a blatant request for money. All other newsletters focus on events and information. Stick with us.
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/4aOlJc2B4/c?w=qdHLK0F12uXpCkB6rDgkqz1IbOa8KvpabQMjNFQM_1w.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL3JhdV95ZWFyX2VuZF8yMDIzIiwiciI6ImZhOTdjMjMwLTgwOTAtNDI1Ni1iYTg5LTQ2MGQ0MmNjMGY5OSIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9)
---
| | |
---
| | Celebrating One Million Delivered!
---
| | In the past four weeks, Rural Americans United’s pro-Democratic radio spots have been heard one million times by listeners throughout Central Washington! For the very first time, thousands of people have been exposed to core Democratic goals with the power to vastly improve the lives of working class people on the eastside of the Cascades. In all, RAU has committed to a $350,000, 14-month media blitz, which will blanket the 4th District with 20,000 separate radio spots. In English and Spanish, the ads are believed to be the largest public awareness campaign ever launched in the state.
---
| |
---
| | The first month of RAU’s remarkable advertising campaign was met with a wave of support pouring in from across the state, thanking us for giving them hope and representation in communities that are often subjected to intimidation and even violence against those that hold democratic values. When I write us, I mean all of us that contribute, write notes of encouragement, support candidates, run for office and so many other things. Winning is never a singular accomplishment, it takes all of us. To keep these inspiring pro-Democratic broadcast messages rolling, Rural Americans United needs your financial support. Please help us celebrate the holiday season and the New Year with great joy, knowing the lives of so many have been touched with good and sensible values. We must raise $43,000 dollars before the end of the year to keep the momentum up. [Click here](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/4aOlJc2B4/c?w=HWgtDa1EXJhwsxQUkx1IXhUvuADo6cy6zxAnCT1itac.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL3JhdV95ZWFyX2VuZF8yMDIzIiwiciI6IjFjNzU4MTI3LWFhZjYtNDQ3OC1iYTA2LWIzZGZlN2RjN2QwOCIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9) to help RAU meet this year's funding goal.
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/4aOlJc2B4/c?w=e4BrjVXEOB8t6j6Se-Tz1nLce3yNEtPBRbrSBYAdelU.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL3JhdV95ZWFyX2VuZF8yMDIzIiwiciI6ImE2MGI3ZDgwLWEzYjUtNDE1Ni1hN2Q1LTdhM2ExNmMyNTM0NiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9)
---
| | |
---
| | Local Media GainsInterest in Democrats
---
| | We are making Central Washington Democrats newsworthy again! For thirty years or more Democrats have had little to no relationship with TV, radio and newspapers. Without solid Democratic political infrastructure, journalists seeking quotes from a Democrat are unsure where to turn. There is a continuous onslaught of Republican noise in Central Washington; but without Democratic media infrastructure, the business of creating responses and structuring information in a form that radio, TV and print journalists can use just doesn’t happen. Without sources for the Democratic side of stories, local media are left with only Republican party rhetoric while the Democratic voice diminishes.
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/4aOlJc2B4/c?w=cC3uMdTB0zcGrh4hAv5EtswbXwFLHNpwJ6cLbnIcs2Q.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL25ld3NsZXR0ZXItMTEuMDguMjMiLCJyIjoiYmVlY2M2ZDQtNWYwNS00NmI3LWEyZmQtMTA0YzY0ZTg1NjVkIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0)
---
| | Starting two years ago, RAU began rebuilding these important relationships with the media to get our story out there. During the last election cycle we started to see the fruits of our efforts. We were able to get pro-Democratic articles published in papers up and down Central Washington as well as in Seattle and Spokane. Additionally, we placed articles calling out the heinous methods that local Republican parties are using to subvert the political process, undermine election integrity and unfairly sway voting to their benefit. As a result of our work, Central Washington media outlets are showing a new interest in Democrat content. We will continue to build on that success, working to increase the visibility and voice of rural Americans. Your generous support is making all the difference! A sample of publications are below.
---

Stick with us. | | | | | | | Celebrating One Million Delivered! | | In the past four weeks, Rural Americans United’s pro-Democratic radio spots have been heard one million times by listeners throughout Central Washington! For the very first time, thousands of people have been exposed to core Democratic goals with the power to vastly improve the lives of working class people on the eastside of the Cascades. In all, RAU has committed to a $350,000, 14-month media blitz, which will blanket the 4th District with 20,000 separate radio spots. In English and Spanish, the ads are believed to be the largest public awareness campaign ever launched in the state. | | | | The first month of RAU’s remarkable advertising campaign was met with a wave of support pouring in from across the state, thanking us for giving them hope and representation in communities that are often subjected to intimidation and even violence against those that hold democratic values. When I write us, I mean all of us that contribute, write notes of encouragement, support candidates, run for office and so many other things. Winning is never a singular accomplishment, it takes all of us. To keep these inspiring pro-Democratic broadcast messages rolling, Rural Americans United needs your financial support. Please help us celebrate the holiday season and the New Year with great joy, knowing the lives of so many have been touched with good and sensible values. We must raise $43,000 dollars before the end of the year to keep the momentum up. to help RAU meet this year's funding goal. | | | | | | | Local Media GainsInterest in Democrats | | We are making Central Washington Democrats newsworthy again! Without solid Democratic political infrastructure, journalists seeking quotes from a Democrat are unsure where to turn.
