subject: the cost of a dozen doughnuts
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-dmp [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-dmp]
Friend, I'm about to ask you to help me hit my $150,000 end-of-month goal. But first, I want to tell you a story about doughnuts — and how they're going to help us save our Senate majority.
(If you're short on time and ready to retire Rick Scott next fall, you can split a donation between my campaign and Serve America to help me make up this fundraising gap and flip Florida blue.) [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-dmp]
When I was 14, my family came to America to seek a better life. We arrived here with big dreams for the future. But those early days were hard. I remember my mom working back-to-back double shifts and still struggling to afford rent for our small, one room apartment.
So, after I turned 15, I got a job working the early morning shift at a local doughnut shop. It was just a minimum wage job, but the small checks I brought home gave my family room to breathe. Finally, after a lot of hard work, the possibilities that we could only dream of before became reality.
We were able to move out of that one room apartment, and I got a scholarship to an incredible college. Eventually, I found a career path where I could give back to the communities and country that gave me so much. That call to service took me to places I had never even dreamed of before. I became the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and now, I'm running for the United States Senate.
Making doughnuts in the morning before homeroom brought me all the way to Congress. I've seen time and time again how small acts have the power to create big, transformative change. And that's exactly how we're going to win this campaign next November.
That's why I'm asking you to split $10 — about the cost of a dozen doughnuts — between my campaign and Serve America to send me to the Senate. Can you chip in before my end-of-month deadline to help me defeat Rick Scott? This campaign is powered by small-dollar donations, and every single gift makes a difference. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-dmp]
Thank you so much,
Debbie Mucarsel-Powell

I was born in Peoria, Illinois where my parents taught me from a young age the importance of family, community, and service to others.

Out-of-touch elites like Josh Hawley have spent decades wasting our money on tax breaks and subsidies for Wall Street, Big Pharma, Big Tech, and just about everything else that’s gutting our country.

The left's relentless pursuit to control the Supreme Court and rewrite the rules is a direct threat to our American values and freedoms. **[We must take immediate action](https://www.nc.gop/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYoX9ls6uHz6nseaLc9yeOc5gJTrfTj8QMzrK5BHQBzw9NwJnr6tOWzxmwUOSFajYsqZLNfpq95ev_IoxBbj49Wqf2jNKzXxZnffriF0BZhvFPyG7DYhwGaPBU06eUjajbUQH8-deyl-x_9CEKoZdZ_qzzZRfj0V-tuP9-CE7T8bU5T2_EqaySrHALhS4RHdMtoE-U-82HxFin3onbjPeOfRZivBd_jeFdH47Zw1ew39AYJwflO9Zw-L6GM69Bb5RnCvtqOXUP96gZ1CrmVTJHwNgxQRd-Si_TY-FhoJGsmGYBHdyu-cAhgdW8uJjc5fF_viVVtJbVj1bUIqRP8rtLgUitQV31ibN5h0dBfsI4rvKRx0AgGKzFqDPsPrkL__eor88Eaw7cNXkuoJYd0UalQ2Fnjg15zpDn2A0B3nd5gFI&e=f30dc52ea6b3f0fa359c0052b3984e35&utm_source=ncgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20231128_hd_breaking_dem_35_30&n=5)** to support and defend our Justices against these unjust attacks. | | | | | Can you f*$&ing believe this, Peter? **Bob Casey (ya know, the Pennsylvania map guy) is running against a mega-millionaire who doesn’t even live in Pennsylvania.** You read that right. David McCormick is a hedge fund executive who has been lying about where he lives (CONNECTICUT!!). I’m setting the record straight. McCormick has been selling out workers in order to get rich – making MILLIONS on Wall Street off the backs of the very people Senator Casey has been fighting for his entire career. But McCormick’s sh*tty record doesn’t stop there. He even said he supports an extreme abortion ban with no exceptions for rape or incest. Pennsylvanians aren’t going to be fooled by this carpetbagger. But in order to show voters who David McCormick really is, we need resources. [**So ahead of Bob Casey’s November fundraising deadline tomorrow night, can you pitch in $5 or more to make sure Bob wins in Pennsylvania?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T93204956-8636-4506-a523-4ada85ed09ea/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Please, if you can, rush an urgent donation to make sure this team has the resources to keep PA and the Senate blue.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6c10b097-502f-41a7-b400-2ed385d5399b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** Thank you in advance, James Carville

https://www.voteheidicampbell.com/ [https://www.voteheidicampbell.com/]
Peter,
As we approach the end of November, thank you for all you have done to support my re-election campaign over the past month. It is an immense privilege to serve District 20, and I am only able to continue this work with your help.
With public education, women’s reproductive rights, increasing gun violence, and so many other issues on the line we need legislators who will stand up for Tennesseans more than ever. This is the most competitive seat in the legislature and we need to hang on to it. Please invest in our campaign (powered by amazing volunteers from across middle Tennessee) now , before session begins at the start of the year (we can’t fundraise during session).
You can chip in to my re-election fund here! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbellforsenate] Any amount will be a great help. You can also support our campaign by becoming a sponsor for our upcoming re-election launch - join our host committee here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbelldec2023] and find more event details below.
It’s hard to believe we are just two months away from returning to session. Republican legislators are already gearing up to gut public schools and attack our most vulnerable communities, while turning a blind eye to issues facing everyday Tennesseans. Let’s continue standing up to the bullies in our legislature - both in the upcoming session and beyond.
Thank you for your consideration, and for continuing to stand with me as we work for a better future for all Tennesseans.
Sen. Heidi Campbell

We can and must take action to end the gun violence epidemic. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74296299/441216241/-272948131?refcode=AU_MTH_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20231130_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS84OTA0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzODY1NWNhYy05OThmLWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=giIjweEhabbyDcwDz2scdLKxm_Xtj-c7rzKWsv2MpWI=&emci=7a4feca3-998f-ee11-8925-002248223f36&emdi=38655cac-998f-ee11-8925-002248223f36&ceid=252045)

Friends — Last year, I led the charge to pass the _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act_ — the first and _only_ congressional action on gun safety reform in three decades. It was no easy feat, but we worked across the aisle to make this landmark legislation law. While an incredible accomplishment, it was only the start of the action we need to take to end gun violence. That’s why I’m introducing the _Gas-Operated Semi-Automatic Firearms Exclusion (GOSAFE) Act_ — a pragmatic approach that will protect our communities from gun violence while defending the constitutional right to own a firearm for self-defense, hunting, or sporting. **[Gun violence has devastated communities across the country, and Congress must take action to end this epidemic. That’s why I’m asking you personally: Will you help build support for this legislation by signing on as a citizen co-sponsor of my _GOSAFE Act_?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74296300/441216245/-947320995?refcode=AU_MTH_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20231130_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS84OTA0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzODY1NWNhYy05OThmLWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=giIjweEhabbyDcwDz2scdLKxm_Xtj-c7rzKWsv2MpWI=&emci=7a4feca3-998f-ee11-8925-002248223f36&emdi=38655cac-998f-ee11-8925-002248223f36&ceid=252045)** | [SIGN ON](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74296303/441216246/-947320995?refcode=AU_MTH_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20231130_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS84OTA0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzODY1NWNhYy05OThmLWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=giIjweEhabbyDcwDz2scdLKxm_Xtj-c7rzKWsv2MpWI=&emci=7a4feca3-998f-ee11-8925-002248223f36&emdi=38655cac-998f-ee11-8925-002248223f36&ceid=252045)
---
Like many Americans, I am a responsible gun owner. We need policies that protect safe gun ownership while getting guns out of the hands of people who pose a threat to themselves or others.
The _GOSAFE Act_ would regulate firearms based on the lethality of their internal mechanisms. It would also regulate the sale, transfer, and manufacture of gas-operated semi-automatic weapons to get these deadly weapons off the streets while allowing law enforcement to do their job to keep communities safe.
We have seen far too many tragic shootings hurt communities in New Mexico and across the country. We can and must take action to end the gun violence epidemic — and passing the _GOSAFE Act_ would be a huge, meaningful step forward.

On Saturday, both of my boys got beautiful cow elk (Badge’s first!) because a generous landowner gave us permission to use their land. No money demand. No acting like elk are owned. They offer this opportunity to any Montanan.

These are the things that make Montana so great. These are the things that make me proud to call Montana my home.

But if Gianforte gets another four year term, he will further privatize our wildlife and our Montana way of living goes out the window. Let me explain...
| [Help me beat Gianforte >>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74296284/441216225/1684620444?source=SBD_RB_EM_FR_NOV23_2_2_EOM&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDgzNDciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiM2U2NTVjYWMtOTk4Zi1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=LUqDrH2F5CgnBvaBncqwxXykGUTAxRhtVjIQcvq3ttk=)
---
Here's a little story about the Texas billionaires who want to turn our state into a playground for the rich. Dan and Farris Wilks are two brothers and oil tycoons from Texas who have made a real splash in the political world donating over $30 MILLION to far-right politicians and PACs. (They’re also spending millions to replace Texas public schools with private schools but that’s a story for another day!)

So what’s all that got to do with Montana? I’ll tell you: **these brothers own over 350,000 acres of land in Montana.** They treat our public lands like a commodity, not the special, sacred thing _real Montanans_ know them to be. And Gianforte’s administration just lets it happen... all because the Wilks have money and influence.

clean_body: Democrats across the country came out and voted in droves. | | | | In previous emails, I've been telling you how tough the Senate races are this cycle and that we have to win 7 out of 7 critical races to keep the Senate out of Mitch McConnell's control. That is the challenging truth. But let's also celebrate some great developments that are good news for 2024! On election day earlier this month, Democrats across the country came out and voted in droves. In Ohio, voters proclaimed that they believe women's health care decisions should be between them and their doctors, not right-wing politicians hellbent on restricting abortion rights. In Virginia, voters chose to send a Democratic majority to the Virginia state Senate and House, stopping MAGA extremists' plan to take total control of state government and enact their out-of-touch agenda. When you're in a challenging fight, you need to seize every advantage you can, and this year’s strong Democratic turnout and continued sign that concerns over abortion restrictions is a motivating issue for voters are both good news for us in 2024. Let's keep that momentum going to grow our grassroots energy all the way until November 5, 2024 – Election Day! Our country can't afford the disaster of another Congress entirely controlled by Republicans. We know what happens when they're in charge – they create chaos and force through dangerous and extreme laws that hurt Americans. = = Onward! Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.
Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild.

# Kristen Mansharamani,
# Special Education Advocate, State of NH
---
---
|
---
In this episode of Navigating Uncertainty, Dr. Mansharamani speaks with Kristen Mansharamani, the Advocate for Special Education for the State of New Hampshire. Kristen tells her story of growing up in Virginia, her decision to attend Yale and Harvard Law School, and the path that took her from successful corporate attorney to education entrepreneur. She concludes with great advice for anyone seeking to overcome challenges as we navigate today's uncertainty: Ask lots of questions, be humble, and think for yourself.
Please tune in via any of the links below, or if you'd prefer to watch the conversation, please visit mansharamani.substack.com for link to the video.
---
PRIOR EPISODES ALL AVAILABLE ON DEMAND!
For those who missed the prior episodes of NAVIGATING UNCERTAINTY, have no fear! They're all available on demand via the links below. As you sit in traffic during your weekend trips, tune in and use the opportunity to learn about some fascinating people as well as some of the most important topics of our times!
You'll find my conversations with Nancy Boutet, Founder and Executive Director of Special Surfers, Jason Osborne, NH House Majority Leader, Bill Greiner, Founder of Primary Bank, Jon Savira-Savett, Rabbi of Temple Beth Abraham in Nashua NH, Charles Miller, Co-Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Lynk Global, Matthew Bartlett, Co-Founder of Darby Field Advisors, Mary Steady, Director of Pupil Services at LinWood Public Schools, Mike Dennehy, Public and Political Affairs Consultant, Lori Van Dusen, Founder of LVW Advisors, Fahim Fazli, Actor and Hollywood Insider, Robert Reynolds, CEO of Putnam Investments, Dr. Benjamin Kilham, founder of the Kilham Bear Center, Ashlee Vance, Author of When the Heavens Went on Sale, Darrell Hartman, Author of The Battle of Ink & Ice, Jim Cantrell, Co-Founder of SpaceX and Founder of Phantom Space, Dean Carucci, CEO of the Portsmouth Regional Hospital, GOP Presidential Candidate Doug Burgum, Jack Heath, Host of Good Morning New Hampshire, John Formella, Attorney General of New Hampshire, Dean Kamen, Founder of DEKA Research, Donald Kreis, Consumer Advocate for the State of NH, Jeremy Hitchcock, Founder of Dyn and Executive Chairman of Minim, Phil Taub, Partner at NixonPeabody and Co-Founder of SWIM WITH A MISSION, Morgan Ortagus, Former Spokesperson for the State Department, David Jordan, Founder of Seven Hills Foundation, John Avlon, Senior Political Analyst at CNN, Derek Leathers, Chairman & CEO of Werner Enterprises, Rudy Glocker, Founder of Burgeon Outdoor, former US Senator Kelly Ayotte, NCUA Vice Chair Kyle Hauptman, Miami Mayor Francis Suarez, NH Governor Chris Sununu, NH Education Czar Frank Edelblut, Commissioner of Business and Economic Affairs Taylor Caswell, GOP Presidential Candidate Vivek Ramaswamy, former Commander of NORAD and Retired Four Star General Lori Robinson, and former Chair of House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence Mike Rogers.

Navigating Uncertainty is a show in which acclaimed global trend-watcher and futurist [Vikram Mansharamani](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Hs1BM_uuR87JNM2JxMI20PHsKjomg8MgozxdutpYKlffUq2JUD9Xyg7Q39sIYZ90APVVsKe3wPpwmd7-HxYrs3IRX1L-lyR59JczEtSLnmDz_HrLeiZJuOO6x52QR66jGHHCDwYOUFySLgrUHVUbrQ==&c=meMClqyjWdQuLUHue-6TmbQcY3r5TA40As6M-6xxj7F_j9xgQGitMg==&ch=G_3dhnODjDQFcwmWq-IALeS2kjPaWuFob0D5b9IAhIwyLQ4eOaxlRQ==) dives into how leaders make decisions. Through long-form conversations that move beyond sound-bites, Dr. Mansharamani explores how some of the most successful people think about tough choices. Serious, irreverent, entertaining, heart-warming, and occasionally tear-jerking, Navigating Uncertainty offers listeners bite-sized authentic biographies of high-impact leaders from all walks of life.Weekly episodes are released every Thursday via Apple Podcast, Spotify and everywhere podcasts are generally available!

To stay in touch with Dr. Mansharaman and to subscribe (for free) to his weekly newsletter, please visit [mansharamani.substack.com](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Hs1BM_uuR87JNM2JxMI20PHsKjomg8MgozxdutpYKlffUq2JUD9Xyk1jiSl4q9WMemE7GVOmgBT9Vr4MI5jqbAqxyeXayZUG3RLugwjmHKtaSWyQfz5R50Bk9FNBesNYDfVIQGH4qGCb1Ij7H6apzqt5lpvGFpeR&c=meMClqyjWdQuLUHue-6TmbQcY3r5TA40As6M-6xxj7F_j9xgQGitMg==&ch=G_3dhnODjDQFcwmWq-IALeS2kjPaWuFob0D5b9IAhIwyLQ4eOaxlRQ==)

clean_body: | | | | Peter, I am thrilled to officially announce my re-election campaign to continue fighting for you in Congress. As your voice, I have remained steadfast in my commitment to the values that make our great state unique. Together, we have achieved significant milestones, working collaboratively to address the needs of our community and advocating for policies that promote prosperity, safety, and economic growth. The challenges we face as a nation require experienced leadership and dedication to the principles that define us. I have led initiatives to strengthen our local economy, improve healthcare accessibility for veterans, and safeguard our state from illegal drugs. I believe in the power of unity, and it is my firm belief that by working together, we can overcome any obstacle and create a future that reflects the aspirations of our community. | I am proud to have the opportunity to represent you and I humbly ask for your support once again. Together, we can build on the progress we have made. Thank you for your continued trust and support. Sincerely, Lori Chavez-DeRemer Congresswoman OR-05 | | | | | | | | | Even as a Congresswoman, Lori’s most important title is mom. That’s how she knows the issues your family faces, and that’s why she fights everyday to make life better for every Oregon family, and every American. Aside from that, all you need to know are the issues she’s fighting for in Congress: If that sounds like the kind of agenda you can get behind, If you’d prefer to give by check, please use the below address: Lori Chavez-DeRemer for Congress 13203 SE 172nd Ave Suite 166 #399 Happy Valley, OR 97086 Forward This message to FIVE FRIENDS AND FAMILY to spread the word on how to achieve a better future for Oregon and America → ** Also text “LORI” to 71800 or click here to receive all of Lori’s messages | | | | Lori Chavez-DeRemer 13203 SE 172nd Ave, Suite 166 #399, Happy Valley, OR 97086 == \-

subject: Have you heard about candidates who’ve been offered $20 million to run against me?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Multiple people running for U.S. Senate and other Congressional seats in
Michigan have said they’ve been offered between $10 and $20 million to run
against me.

As the only Palestinian American in Congress, I will not be bullied. This
attempt to intimidate me will never silence me in saving as many lives as
possible, no matter faith or ethnicity.

I keep thinking about the three Palestinian students in Vermont, whose
mere existence was seen as a threat by someone who decided to open fire.
Hisham, one of the survivors of the shooting, is right when he said: “This
hideous crime did not happen in a vacuum.”

Silencing the voices of Palestinians and all oppressed people is something
that the political establishment has done for decades. We are saying
enough.

Amidst the painful dehumanizing of Palestinians and hate in the United
States towards our communities (especially those speaking out for a
ceasefire), we must be heard and represented in our government. I will not
let extremists who believe in wiping out as many Palestinians as possible
undermine the democratic will of the American people, the vast majority of
whom support a permanent ceasefire.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231130-1-rt.ELnrWQ&refcode=em20231130-32102&amount=3&t=1001&akid=32102%2E1203867%2Eq_TJ1u ]I will never stop speaking up for Palestinians’ humanity, even when it
makes me a target. As wealthy and powerful people try to take me down, I
need your help to show them we aren't going anywhere. Please make a
donation today.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231130-1-rt.ELnrWQ&refcode=em20231130-32102&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=32102%2E1203867%2Eq_TJ1u ]Contribute $3

Please know I will never back down in speaking truth to power even if my
voice shakes. I refuse to take any money from corporate PACs, so our
campaign is powered by grassroots donors like you.

In solidarity,

Rashida

ACROSS THE COMMONWEALTH
VOTE TODAY! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/Make%20A%20Plan%20To%20Vote.png]
You can vote for November's elections NOW! Vote at your Registrar's office during business hours. Saturday early voting is available October 28th and November 4th. Learn More [https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup]
Find your local Registrar's office here: https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup [https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/VWCC.jpeg] 15 years of the Community College Access Program at VWCC
Learn More [https://www.wdbj7.com/2023/09/26/virginia-western-celebrates-15th-anniversary-ccap-program/] CCAP is a successful public/private partnership that pays the cost of tuition for three years at Virginia Western Community College if a qualified student does not have sufficient financial aid to pay tuition costs.
This program has helped over 4,200 students achieve higher education!
CANDIDATE SPOTLIGHT
https://karenforvirginia.com/ [https://karenforvirginia.com/] Karen Jenkins for HB-89
Donate Here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/karenforvirginia] Karen Jenkins is a life-long resident of the City of Suffolk. Throughout her lifetime she has passionately advocated for others and currently serves on the Suffolk School Board with a proven track record and history of accomplishments. She is running for the House of Delegates for the 89th District to continue delivering results for the people of Virginia.
She is a champion for education, public safety and mental health. As your next Delegate for the 89th District, she will continue to fight and vote for meaningful policies and legislation to support the needs of the district. At the state level, she will be positioned to write and sponsor bills and laws to benefit the schools and communities in the 89th District and throughout the commonwealth.

Join us for the 6th Annual Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game, being held at the Home of the Salem Red Sox - Carilion Clinic Field. A dignified sculpture will commemorate the ongoing and long unrecognized contributions of Roanoke native Henrietta Lacks, who unknowingly provided the world with the HeLa cell, fueling decades of life-saving and life changing research.

Admission is $5 at the gate, kids under 10 free. Gates open at 1pm and the game starts at 2pm. 410 3rd St SW, Roanoke, VA 24011

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

name: Yazmin at United We Dream Action
subject: The golden ticket
body:
| | | Peter, In June 2021, I was approved for DACA for the very first time — I felt like I won the golden ticket. What should have been relief and celebration turned to fear and anger just a month later, when Judge Hanen ruled against DACA and shut down the program for new applicants. While I was grateful for the protection from deportation, work permit, and access to higher education that came with my DACA status, it was a bittersweet feeling knowing the same relief and protections were taken away from thousands of other eligible immigrants — **_including my father_**. You see, my father was also eligible for DACA, and we always imagined getting our applications approved together. _But he never heard back about his application._ The truth is, my father and our communities should have never faced this ruling in the first place. **We have progressed past the need for temporary solutions like DACA — we need a pathway to citizenship now.** That’s exactly what I told Vice President Kamala Harris when I was invited to the White House to honor the 10th anniversary of DACA. If our immigrant youth-led movement has the organizing power to get an undocumented immigrant like me face-to-face with the Vice President of the United States, we also have the power to create the future we want to see — _like permanent protections for all 11 million undocumented people._ **Will you chip in during Giving Week to help United We Dream Action keep the pressure on President Biden and Congress to deliver a pathway to citizenship? clean_body: | | | Peter, In June 2021, I was approved for DACA for the very first time — I felt like I won the golden ticket. What should have been relief and celebration turned to fear and anger just a month later, when Judge Hanen ruled against DACA and shut down the program for new applicants. While I was grateful for the protection from deportation, work permit, and access to higher education that came with my DACA status, it was a bittersweet feeling knowing the same relief and protections were taken away from thousands of other eligible immigrants — including my father. You see, my father was also eligible for DACA, and we always imagined getting our applications approved together. But he never heard back about his application. The truth is, my father and our communities should have never faced this ruling in the first place. We have progressed past the need for temporary solutions like DACA — we need a pathway to citizenship now. That’s exactly what I told Vice President Kamala Harris when I was invited to the White House to honor the 10th anniversary of DACA. If our immigrant youth-led movement has the organizing power to get an undocumented immigrant like me face-to-face with the Vice President of the United States, we also have the power to create the future we want to see — like permanent protections for all 11 million undocumented people. Will you chip in during Giving Week to help United We Dream Action keep the pressure on President Biden and Congress to deliver a pathway to citizenship? | | | My fellow Americans - this is Mike Johnson.

_**[This is a longer email but I'm humbly asking you to read it start to finish.](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=9fa157dd2b5745ff8c8a0f871e870e4a&_e=e_MP69z7E9TvZ4-LPLRGmUTeNOoIBSj4THMZVwVrC6EVic-ftOau8EjdMg8ZQTZ5aaNQt3L7qKqiM6-ePtO0gHXyb7n_AMEfMt3v1-lNTbMabBOhC-d7XroDmbVe_JMn80MmLpvWdfTNipm_PE8QKpwqPX1MPjDIzh9sy_METStxxzkDrTwE77091y-76YzVkNGg_urREKkNxFIcDTidLMDZYF2H86rwDsWUAb4SXpNatOqtn_a3eTZmPpkZcpgrumY3Ktmu1_cPFPMgarAWd8RNpLakVVZG_qnLaJNAihxMUKKr0XiGqRvyjUyycW14iPx7gLhBnKt3_1l5tZev6k3bRtlqUCjUVXSl7ulpcng1ncthpjnRXGKmthdKVcH1N4sdX7lg_moGyVWkRnCkwg%3D%3D "This is a longer email but I’m humbly asking you to read it start to finish.")**_

Why? Because the moment I was elected Speaker by my Republican colleagues, the Radical Left IMMEDIATELY unleashed a coordinated, preplanned political hit job against me.
* The Liberal Media spun up hit piece after hit piece to smear me in the press - Biden's former Press Secretary even attacked me for being a Christian on MSNBC.
* Politico fired off this headline: _" Democrats rev up the opposition machine against Mike Johnson."_
* And I can't even begin to tell you how many Democrat fundraising emails and texts I saw in the minutes following the final vote - I'm bracing myself for the next FEC reports.

Look:

These vicious attacks are a dime a dozen in Washington. They don't intimidate me. _But I 'll let you in on a little secret: that's not _really_ the goal..._

The _real_ goal of this political ambush is two-fold: **1)** smear the good names of every House Republican to hurt them electorally, and **2)** scare Liberals enough to whip out their credit cards, fill in their info, and donate to Democrats.

**It 's about power and money. Nothing else.**

That's why it's mission-critical that we stand up for ourselves in critical moments like this. _**[So as one of my first moves as Speaker, I'm teaming up with my fellow Louisianian - Majority Leader Steve Scalise - to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=9fa157dd2b5745ff8c8a0f871e870e4a&_e=e_MP69z7E9TvZ4-LPLRGmUTeNOoIBSj4THMZVwVrC6EVic-ftOau8EjdMg8ZQTZ5aaNQt3L7qKqiM6-ePtO0gHXyb7n_AMEfMt3v1-lNTbMabBOhC-d7XroDmbVe_JMn80MmLpvWdfTNipm_PE8QKpwqPX1MPjDIzh9sy_METStxxzkDrTwE77091y-76YzVkNGg_urREKkNxFIcDTidLMDZYF2H86rwDsWUAb4SXpNatOqtn_a3eTZmPpkZcpgr8LCvMezFpzNVImAyh2O2JmieNLKLXIB99M-ddny0xHhH0UPlGVrgpNN9IqV8K6cXkL1IQjc0rnWaqXDT1k2pEruwcb__cgk5ovVnFzz0xQH0keMswKyZPrP0rgcGYIKJvnAKNGF3c45TPkvSgKrvZw%3D%3D "So as one of my first moves as Speaker, I’m teaming up with my fellow Louisianian – Majority Leader Steve Scalise – to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.")**_

It's ambitious. I get it. But that's the bare minimum we need to fully fund our campaign operations in battleground races across the country.

**If we fall short of that, we 'll be forced to SLASH our voter contact budgets, GUT our digital outreach efforts, and pull our ads OFF THE AIRWAVES. Nothing could be worse for our plans to defend and expand our slim House Majority.**

So here's my final pitch to you:

We urgently need your help. Not next week, not in the new year - right here and right now.

The difference between a strong Conservative Majority and one controlled by the Liberal Machine will come down to can't-miss fundraising goals just like this.

Let me make myself perfectly clear:

_I 'm not asking you to pitch in more than you can afford. If you can spare $50 or $100, I would be tremendously grateful. But if you can only spare $5 or $10, I would be equally appreciative._

_**[The ONLY thing I ask is for every Conservative in the country to chip in SOMETHING.](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=9fa157dd2b5745ff8c8a0f871e870e4a&_e=e_MP69z7E9TvZ4-LPLRGmUTeNOoIBSj4THMZVwVrC6EVic-ftOau8EjdMg8ZQTZ5aaNQt3L7qKqiM6-ePtO0gHXyb7n_AMEfMt3v1-lNTbMabBOhC-d7XroDmbVe_JMn80MmLpvWdfTNipm_PE8QKpwqPX1MPjDIzh9sy_METStxxzkDrTwE77091y-76YzVkNGg_urREKkNxFIcDTidLMDZYF2H86rwDsWUAb4SXpNatOqtn_a3eTZmPpkZcpgr9wV-XvaK2uZsztD3ck4gE4ZxWimkvVhrSuozjC0UBfH4wRW5z-7bQwMpAIutb38cqT6uPSsYFi-8j3Pu-Ngdg0flSr5jwstQleEpX7vGOWVh6Ngvg6RatjRwMVYzwxJVF7vlgeH74SJryl4_07aARA%3D%3D "The ONLY thing I ask is for every Conservative in the country to chip in SOMETHING.")**_

Friend,
As a Scout, I learned early on that our duty to country involves " helping others at all times." I taught it as a counselor for five years, and it's been my mantra ever since.
Spending my life in service as a social worker, family doctor, educator, and diplomat has been an honor. Now, I'm eager to take on the duties of being a Representative in Congress because my district sorely needs better leadership.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/RESPONSIBILITIES.png]
We need a Congressman willing to work hard, study issues, and serve everyone , including people with whom we disagree.
Rep. Jack Bergman's support of legislation that helps others is few and far between and he must be replaced.
, I 'm committed to enacting real change for the people of Michigan's 1st District and I'm grateful for your support on our journey to Congress to make it happen.
Thank you,
-Dr. Bob
Bob Lorinser
Candidate for US Congress
Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula
Democrat, MI01

name: Team Cori
subject: What it means to run a grassroots campaign
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Cori Bush for Congress
body:
The money you donate goes towards resources for organizers, volunteers, and staffers to bring our community together on the ground. | |
---
Peter, **** **So many campaigns send emails about the importance of reaching their end-of-month goal, but not as many talk about what that money will go towards. We want to change that.** As we’ve said before, we’re raising money to overcome the millions of dollars that rightwing billionaire-backed PACs are going to spend smearing Cori with baseless, bad-faith attack ads, but we’re also raising money to build our people power here in St. Louis. **The money you donate to our campaign will go towards resources for organizers, volunteers, and staffers to bring our community together on the ground.** This looks like money going to:
* **Printing yard signs** : for people to show their support for Cori.
* **Online mobilization services** : so we can recruit people in the community to canvass, call, and organize together.
* **Equitable pay for campaign staff** : so that those doing the hard work for this campaign behind the scenes are compensated for all the time and energy they pour into helping our people-powered movement win.
* **Hosting community events** : so we can bring people together and empower our community to work together towards a better future
* **Literature** : so we can let every voter know what Cori stands for and combat the misinformation.

These are just a few of our people-powered tactics that grassroots donations help support. ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
I was talking with someone the other day about our two-year election cycle, and they observed that those of us elected every two years are always running, always campaigning, always asking. And it’s true. It feels like I’m writing to you about another deadline all the time. And I am. Because we take nothing for granted. And we need to do everything we can to win.
We set deadlines for each week, each month, each quarter, and each year all to support one goal: winning in 2024.
And when I say winning in 2024, I mean making sure that we win in TX-07, and making sure Democrats win up and down the ballot. Because the stakes are too high to do anything else.
Take it from me. I’ve seen the difference in what we can do in Congress when Democrats control the House and a Democrat is in the White House. I’ve also seen what happens when we are not. We have all seen this year the chaos, confusion, and cruelty that characterize the current Congress. We can’t keep going this way. And we can only imagine what will happen if Donald Trump is successful in his effort to return to the White House.
That’s why we are so focused on this campaign on doing all the things we can for 2024. And I want to thank everyone who’s contributed [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe231130?refcode=lpfe231130] over the past couple of weeks to this effort.
Winning takes all kinds of contributions—knocking on doors, making phone calls, financial support.
Since today is our first end-of-month fundraising deadline since I filed for re-election, I’m hoping you will help us reach our goal by making a financial contribution. You can do that by clicking here. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe231130?refcode=lpfe231130]

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: 2 years since the Oxford High School shooting
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
#

Team -
Two years ago today, I was on a Zoom in Washington when my staff interrupted the meeting to tell me we had an active shooter at Oxford High School. I flew back home and went straight to the office of the Oakland County Sheriff. What unfolded that day would forever change our state: The small town of Oxford, and the entire surrounding area, was irreparably changed by an act of senseless violence when a gunman opened fire on his classmates. He killed 4 teenagers, injured another 7 students and teachers, and left a lifetime of pain and heartbreak for an entire community.
It’s important to me that we remember the four students whose lives were so tragically cut short:
Hana St. Juliana was a 14-year-old freshman volleyball and basketball player. Hana, who used to babysit for a friend of mine, had just played in her very first high school basketball game right before the shooting.
Madisyn Baldwin was a 17-year-old artist, writer, reader, and beloved sister. Madisyn was preparing to attend college, and had already secured several full-ride scholarships.
Tate Myre was a 16-year-old varsity football player who excelled both on the field and in the classroom. He was a hard-working honors student who was just coming into his own.
Justin Shilling was a 17-year-old senior who was involved both at school and in the community. He worked part-time at a restaurant in the neighboring town of Lake Orion, and co-captained the Oxford High School bowling team.
Any time a tragedy like this happens, it tears a hole in the fabric of a community. It leaves unseen wounds on the psyche of an entire community. No one in our area was left unscathed – the aftershocks of this senseless act of violence leave a lasting impact for two years and beyond.
But today as we remember the victims of this senseless act of violence, I am also remembering the incredible responses that we saw in the wake of the tragedy: the bravery, the heroism, and the helpers, in uniform and without, who banded together in the aftermath. They provided a bright spot in the darkness of this horrific event.
I am remembering the law enforcement officers and first responders, who put themselves in harm’s way in the immediate aftermath of the shooting. In under five minutes, the shooter fired 30 rounds of ammunition, but he still had rounds left when he was stopped by law enforcement.
I am remembering the 911 dispatchers who fielded over 100 calls in just minutes, calmly using their training to quickly send responders to the scene.
I am remembering the teachers who reacted within seconds to secure their students, making sure the shooter couldn’t enter their classrooms.
I am remembering the medical professionals – doctors, nurses, EMS, hospital staff, of whom we have already asked so much in recent times – who stepped in to provide top-notch care to the wounded.
I am remembering the prosecutors and staff who have been working on this case since the day of the attack.
And I am remembering the students, parents, the friends, the neighbors and co-workers and community members who all stepped up to show that the people of Oxford will have each other’s backs.
When students, babies, are murdered in their school – a place that’s supposed to be their sanctuary – we must conclude that we are failing to provide basic safety and security for our children. The reality is that we’re also failing to show moral leadership.
Just a few weeks ago, an independent report of the Oxford school shooting laid out failures that led to the Oxford shooting. As a legislator, it’s my job to read, digest, and work with officials in our state to do everything we can to prevent another tragedy like this happening in Michigan ever again.
Oxford will be remembered as a town our kids read about in history books, joining a long list of other horrific attacks. Columbine. Virginia Tech. Sandy Hook. Parkland. Santa Fe. And just this year, the shooting and subsequent manhunt at another school in my district — Michigan State University, on February 13, 2023. One of the most haunting images from that day, as I watched the screens at the East Lansing Police Department, was watching an MSU student run across campus, terrified – wearing an “Oxford Strong” sweatshirt.
We had young people who had now lived through two school shootings, and it broke my heart.
Like many Michiganders, I grew up with guns. I carried a Glock and an M4 on three tours in Iraq alongside the military. But I also now have the dubious honor of being the first Congresswoman in America to represent two school shootings in the span of 14 months, so I can also tell you that of all the terrible things I saw abroad in combat zones, nothing has been as terrible as seeing the aftermath of a school shooting.
But two years on, I believe there is hope. Within two months, Michigan went from a state that hadn’t passed substantial gun violence legislation in 40 years to a state that is now leading the country and showing people what it means to actually pass gun safety legislation. Less than 8 weeks after the shooting at MSU, we passed universal background checks, safe storage requirements for anyone who has a child in the home, and red flag laws to remove guns from people who are threatening to harm themselves or others.
Hopefully, Michigan can be seen as an example for other efforts across the country. And I won’t stop pushing for reform at the federal level. As terrible as this is, at some point, so many Americans will be personally impacted by gun violence that we will be forced to make change at the federal level. And I plan to be a part of that change when I get to the Senate.
Thank you for reading.
Elissa

PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
P.O. Box 4145
East Lansing, MI 48826

But I also now have the dubious honor of being the first Congresswoman in America to represent two school shootings in the span of 14 months, so I can also tell you that of all the terrible things I saw abroad in combat zones, nothing has been as terrible as seeing the aftermath of a school shooting. But two years on, I believe there is hope. Within two months, Michigan went from a state that hadn’t passed substantial gun violence legislation in 40 years to a state that is now leading the country and showing people what it means to actually pass gun safety legislation. Less than 8 weeks after the shooting at MSU, we passed universal background checks, safe storage requirements for anyone who has a child in the home, and red flag laws to remove guns from people who are threatening to harm themselves or others. Hopefully, Michigan can be seen as an example for other efforts across the country. And I won’t stop pushing for reform at the federal level. As terrible as this is, at some point, so many Americans will be personally impacted by gun violence that we will be forced to make change at the federal level. And I plan to be a part of that change when I get to the Senate. Thank you for reading. Elissa PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN P.O. Box 4145 East Lansing, MI 48826

Hey Peter,
When I was a kid, my mom would roll out pastie dough, and we’d chop onions, carrots, rutabaga, potatoes, and beef, and we’d make 30 or 40 pasties at a time (some for dinner and some for the freezer). And then, Mom would make gravy for us kids while my dad hoarded the ketchup bottle. As an adult — I go 50/50 (half gravy/half ketchup). Childhood memories with gravy — ketchup for the refined palate.
Regardless, the age old debate looms: does your family eat their pasties with ketchup or gravy?

Friend, The majority of Americans―nearly 70%―support a ceasefire. However, the U.S. House voted to send billions of dollars in unconditional aid to the Israeli government to continue the killing of Palestinian civilians. As the fragile, temporary ceasefire holds for the moment, we need even more people of all backgrounds speaking out in support of Palestinian rights and humanity. That’s why, this week, I was proud to stand alongside activists and elected officials who are now in the fourth day of a hunger strike in front of the White House. **Among the state representatives striking to demand President Biden support an immediate and permanent ceasefire are Delaware State Representative Madinah Wilson-Anton―the first Muslim state representative in Delaware―and New York State Assemblymember Zohran Kwame Mamdani.** Both Madinah and Zohran are taking a courageous stand to bring attention to the suffering of Palestinians who have been without clean water, food, shelter, and medical supplies. More than 14,000―the majority women and children―have already been killed by the indiscriminate bombing of Gaza. However, the U.S. House voted to send billions of dollars in unconditional aid to the Israeli government to continue the killing of Palestinian civilians. As the fragile, temporary ceasefire holds for the moment, we need even more people of all backgrounds speaking out in support of Palestinian rights and humanity. That’s why, this week, I was proud to stand alongside activists and elected officials who are now in the fourth day of a hunger strike in front of the White House. Among the state representatives striking to demand President Biden support an immediate and permanent ceasefire are Delaware State Representative Madinah Wilson-Anton―the first Muslim state representative in Delaware―and New York State Assemblymember Zohran Kwame Mamdani. Both Madinah and Zohran are taking a courageous stand to bring attention to the suffering of Palestinians who have been without clean water, food, shelter, and medical supplies. More than 14,000―the majority women and children―have already been killed by the indiscriminate bombing of Gaza. | This week, Madinah said of why she’s working to bring attention to the pain and suffering of Palestinians in Gaza: And Zohran reminded us of the humanity of the thousands who have been killed: As anti-Arab, Muslim, and Palestinian attacks increase in the United States and across the globe, Madinah, Zohran, and many others are demanding that President Biden and members of Congress not look away, but instead join the vast majority of Americans in demanding an immediate and permanent ceasefire. I’m writing to you today because I am proud to endorse Debbie Mucarsel-Powell for U.S. Senate in Florida.

| Peter —

I’m writing to you today because I am proud to endorse Debbie Mucarsel-Powell for U.S. Senate in Florida.

I love Florida, and am proud to call it home — but our state has been victim to some of the worst mass shootings in our country. Florida families, including mine, have been shattered by shootings in Parkland, Fort Lauderdale, and Orlando.

I know from personal experience that Florida desperately needs a leader in the United States Senate who cares about public safety and fiercely defends the right of every Floridian to live free of gun violence. Debbie Murcasel-Powell is that leader. Meanwhile, as a Senator, Rick Scott has sided with the gun lobby every time.

Debbie is up against a man who bought this Senate seat for himself last time round — and still only won by less than 1%! I hope you’ll join me in supporting Debbie Mucarsel-Powell for Senate by splitting a gift between her campaign and Fight for Progress— with grassroots support, I know she can deliver the leadership Florida deserves.

Dear Governor Gavin Newsom,

This is Team DeSantis reaching out. We see right through Bidenomics. In fact, we think it’s kind of insulting that Biden has tried to convince Americans that the outrageous prices they’re paying for everything are good for us... A lot of people can’t afford to eat right now... It’s all a sham. Anyway, we just wanted to let you know that we’ve seen what you’re doing in California, and Newsomonics is even worse.

You’ve made California only livable for the ultra-rich, and you know what? Here on our team, we’re standing up for the average American.

Not to mention, you’re willing to give hand-outs to illegal aliens, but you’ve made your cost of living, taxes, and energy prices so outrageous that your people are fleeing as fast as they can. Don’t you see the problem?

We think you’re a giant, flashing warning sign to this country. And that’s exactly why our guy is up on stage proving you wrong and exposing your liberal lies.

>From California dreaming to California leaving—that’s your story. We’re going to make sure this one stays in the past, because we have no room for a continued failing economy in America’s future.

Sincerely,

Team Ron DeSantis for President

We’re going to make sure Gavin Newsom, and every liberal elite that wants to raise your taxes, control your life, and strip away your freedom, get the picture. They need to see this. And Ron DeSantis needs to take this fight to the White House. We need your support now, friend.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=2cf6a3a2f19b7f50555957acc36c92e66097f226a38d11f641d370466e018ed11df96587f195d9ddd39a6812ab8e6186348a449564cd120789c087478329dc22

SUPPORT RON DESANTIS FOR PRESIDENT

In Freedom,

Team DeSantis

🚨 ATTENTION 🚨

Heads up! We have pre-checked the monthly donor box on our fundraising page. Monthly donors make a HUGE difference for our team and help ups plan ahead.

If one donation was all it took to defeat Joe Biden next November then we wouldn't ask for your help more than we already have, but unfortunately it's going to take more than that to win.

Please keep this box checked so we that we can count on your support.

Volunteer!

We welcome you to join Team DeSantis by volunteering to spread our message: Decline is a choice. Success is attainable. And freedom is worth fighting for.

Help us lead our Great American Comeback by getting involved today!

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=2cf6a3a2f19b7f5069d22e0c109e3392f213f348694052fa6ca534d88f5b5fdf537918078c70f2f33f94067cf9631924d96484fa648e06a9a4bd57cfe3b88f59
Sign up here!

Get to Know Ron DeSantis

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=2cf6a3a2f19b7f50555957acc36c92e66097f226a38d11f641d370466e018ed11df96587f195d9ddd39a6812ab8e6186348a449564cd120789c087478329dc22

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=2cf6a3a2f19b7f50555957acc36c92e66097f226a38d11f641d370466e018ed11df96587f195d9ddd39a6812ab8e6186348a449564cd120789c087478329dc22

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

| Folks,

Like many, my partner Paolo and I came of age at a time when being gay was still considered a crime in many states.

I often reflect back to when I was 17 years old in the wake of 9/11. I had a deep sense of duty to serve the country, but policies like “Don’t Ask, Don’t Tell” discouraged me from joining the military.

Thanks to the brave LGBTQ+ Americans who came before me and had the courage to come out, I eventually got the chance to work openly in law enforcement and counterterrorism. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74319406/441290254/-1729839915?amount=10&amounts=3,5,7,10&refcode=RRFC_20231130_EMSPL_E1_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDcvMS8xMDc4NzAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjkzYWQ4MWYtYmQ4Zi1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=4GTPRJwFV-v6WlwLbJCxlEP_EMiU6lS-BzWpfAcyvGw=) _Paolo and I recently at Palm Springs Pride._ Despite the strides we've taken toward equality, the recent election of Speaker Mike Johnson proves the GOP is hell-bent on turning back the clock on LGBTQ+ rights.

Johnson’s record reads like something out of an anti-LGBTQ+ hate group’s wish list. Aside from voting against marriage equality just last year, he:
* Is on record supporting the criminalization of sexual acts between consenting LGBTQ+ adults,

* Previously worked with an organization that pushed so-called conversion therapy,

* Claimed that a ‘homosexual agenda’ will destroy society and likened being LGBTQ+ to pedophilia and bestiality. Really.

The fact that the Speaker of the House doesn’t respect Paolo's and my right to love is shocking -- especially in 2023. And the fact that Ken Calvert and the entire Republican Party handed him the Speaker’s gavel is even more horrifying.

We can send a clear message that rejects Johnson’s hateful agenda by turning the House blue next year. That starts by flipping CA-41.

Strong grassroots support here in Montana: check 4. Cash to compete: we're not there yet I'm hopeful you'll see this note today and decide In 2024, as goes Montana, so goes the Senate. Friends,
As time goes by, I find myself increasingly worried about the cultural state of our great nation. This week, I was lucky to be joined by one of the wisest men I know, Dennis Prager.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/078a3911-2124-4467-9a53-953ca6ff20c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
It was a very rich conversation where we talked about Liberalism, Leftism, Secularism, Culture more broadly, and more...
"The challenge is to persuade liberals that the left is their enemy, not the right."
\- Dennis Prager
Despite the state of our Nation and the seemingly always more decadent culture, especially of our youth, speaking with Dennis always gives me a sense of optimism.
I hope you will listen to one of my favorite conversations this year.

name: Friends of the Earth
subject: Your Signature is Needed: Ships carrying invasive species into our oceans and lakes
body:
| | | | | [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e_s17_main_cobrandedemail_c3)
---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Alien species INVADING our waterways by hitching rides on under-regulated ships![_Tell the EPA to regulate ballast water to protect our oceans and waterways!_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2165399?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** In the 1980s, invasive zebra mussels arrived in the Great Lakes. This tiny, shelled creature doesn’t look intimidating, but it has **completely overtaken the Great Lakes** in just a few decades, with devastating effects on people and the ecosystem. Zebra mussels outcompete native species and remove crucial plankton that native fish need to survive. They clog and corrode pipelines, ship hulls, and other equipment important to local economies. And they’ve spread like the plague – an estimated _**750 TRILLION**_ zebra mussels dwell in the Great Lakes today. The culprit of this tragic spread is ballast water – water held in ships for stability. Ballast water is often harvested in one part of the world and dumped in another, carrying invasive species with it. The **EPA has proposed new rules to supposedly PROTECT our oceans, Great Lakes, and waterways from ballast water -- but they aren’t strong enough!** The window to submit comments is closing and we need your help, Friend. [**_If just 1 of every 9 people reading this email takes action, we can FIGHT invasive species and keep our water safe! Please, Friend, sign the petition now!_**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2165400?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [Sign the petition](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2165401?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Big vessels like cruise ships also create a lot of waste in the form of graywater – this is water collected from shower, baths, sinks, and laundry facilities. **Think about all the gross stuff that gets flushed down the drain** – bacteria, disease, soap oils, metals like lead and copper – all of that is often _**dumped into our oceans**_ and waterways.
This pollution can wash onto shore and harm coastal communities. It also impacts the fish that many local economies rely on. We can’t let polluted graywater get recklessly dumped into the ocean. It seems like a no-brainer, but it’s still happening right now.
Our oceans are deteriorating every day we don’t act. They’re being _**overtaken with plastics,**_ cruise ships are _**dumping polluted wastewater,**_ and all sorts of boats are _**carrying invasive species.**_ The EPA’s new proposed rules on ballast water need to be stronger and your action telling EPA to take a stand will make a HUGE difference right now. [_**Will you take just 30 seconds and send your message to the EPA? Stand up to Big Cruise companies and sign your name!**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2165402?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
[Sign the petition](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2165401?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
**Standing with you,
Marcie Keever
Oceans and vessels program director,
Friends of the Earth**

This tiny, shelled creature doesn’t look intimidating, but it has completely overtaken the Great Lakes in just a few decades, with devastating effects on people and the ecosystem. Zebra mussels outcompete native species and remove crucial plankton that native fish need to survive. They clog and corrode pipelines, ship hulls, and other equipment important to local economies. And they’ve spread like the plague – an estimated 750 TRILLION zebra mussels dwell in the Great Lakes today. The culprit of this tragic spread is ballast water – water held in ships for stability. Ballast water is often harvested in one part of the world and dumped in another, carrying invasive species with it. The EPA has proposed new rules to supposedly PROTECT our oceans, Great Lakes, and waterways from ballast water -- but they aren’t strong enough! The window to submit comments is closing and we need your help, Friend. == | == Big vessels like cruise ships also create a lot of waste in the form of graywater – this is water collected from shower, baths, sinks, and laundry facilities. Think about all the gross stuff that gets flushed down the drain – bacteria, disease, soap oils, metals like lead and copper – all of that is often dumped into our oceans and waterways. This pollution can wash onto shore and harm coastal communities. It also impacts the fish that many local economies rely on. We can’t let polluted graywater get recklessly dumped into the ocean. It seems like a no-brainer, but it’s still happening right now. Our oceans are deteriorating every day we don’t act. They’re being overtaken with plastics, cruise ships are dumping polluted wastewater, and all sorts of boats are carrying invasive species. The EPA’s new proposed rules on ballast water need to be stronger and your action telling EPA to take a stand will make a HUGE difference right now. == == Standing with you, Marcie Keever Oceans and vessels program director, Friends of the Earth | Contact Us: Friends of the Earth U.S. Washington, D.C. | Berkeley, CA 1-877-843-8687

Friend,

Breaking : Atlanta Journal Constitution - Redrawn House Redistricting Maps Target Rising Democrats

Peter,

Today, the Georgia House of Representatives is in a Special Legislative Session to redraw our state’s electoral maps.

We warned radical Republicans in 2021 that their proposed maps both violated the Voting Rights Act and disenfranchised Georgia’s Black and minority voters. But they passed the maps anyway. And last month, a judge agreed with us and declared the Republican-led maps unconstitutional.

As we deliberate new electoral maps to reflect the will of the voters, Leader Beverly delivered a clear truth: the new Republican-drawn maps fail to meet that standard under the Voting Rights Act - again. Georgia voters deserve equal and just representation, and the Democratic alternative maps do just that for the Georgia House.

Georgia House Democrats fight to preserve the right of Georgia’s voters to choose their elected leaders, not the other way around. Radical Republicans fight back because they know that, if the maps are drawn justly and equitably as we have proposed, Democrats will be within striking distance of restoring our Majority in the Georgia House.

Leader Beverly stated, "In 2021, we vehemently condemned the Republicans' actions, which blatantly undermined the principles of democracy by diluting Black and minority voting power and we are satisfied that a federal judge agreed." Today is a solemn day in the state of Georgia, but tomorrow will be a better one if we can preserve the will of the people in the People’s House.

It’s your support that allows us to continue our fight for equitable and just electoral representation. Will you chip in - $25, $10, or whatever you can spare - today?

Georgia House Democrats

body:
I've been thinking back on when I launched Courier. When we first got started...

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74324217/441304307/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTY2YWRmOWQtYzc4Zi1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=xGPS5VBROewk6Sa4ruetLYRESNbexNlvoFb1K1hsfyE=&emci=fdc725d3-b88f-ee11-8925-002248223f36&emdi=566adf9d-c78f-ee11-8925-002248223f36&ceid=14016711)
Hey Peter, it's Tara McGowan — Founder and Publisher of Courier Newsroom.
For far too long, we’ve watched mainstream news organizations prioritize profit over good journalism.
First, in 2016, Donald Trump won the White House, in part by using mainstream media outlets to sow division and spread lies, hate, and conspiracy theories.
Then, in 2020, right-wing disinformation campaigns about election security and fraud spread unchecked and **directly led** to the violence we all witnessed at the Capitol on January 6th.
I founded Courier on the belief that the best antidote to the spread of lies and conspiracy theories is increasing the volume of good, factual information in the online spaces where people actually get their news, like inboxes or social media feeds.
**Together, we achieved so much this year, and I’m grateful that you’ve been a part of this journey. As this month ends, and with the 2024 election on the horizon, my belief in the urgency and impact of our work is stronger than ever.**
[**We've got big plans for 2024, from growing our existing newsrooms to branching out into new states — but our ability to put those plans into action depends on us reaching our end-of-month fundraising goals like this. Will you chip in $5 today to help us raise the final resources we need to hit our $15,000 goal?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74324218/441304308/828936621?refcode=em20231130&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTY2YWRmOWQtYzc4Zi1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=xGPS5VBROewk6Sa4ruetLYRESNbexNlvoFb1K1hsfyE=)
**_The stakes for 2024 are high Peter._** Since 2020, Trump and MAGA Republicans' rhetoric has only become more violent, more authoritarian, and more untethered from reality. It's not an understatement to say that there is a possibility that a literal fascist could be re-elected to the White House.
**Unfortunately, there’s still very little evidence that mainstream media organizations have learned from their mistakes of the past.**
Rather than calling out lies and conspiracy theories for what they are, mainstream media has remained steadfast in an out-of-date model that covers “both sides” and platforms professional liars and grifters who do not have the best interest of our democracy at heart.
What’s more, is that as local newsrooms continue to close across the country, leaving more and more Americans in “news deserts” or communities without reliable, trustworthy local news.

body:
They need to hear from you...

Peter - we've always known the deep-pockets in Washington wouldn't back my outsider campaign for the Congressional 47th District.

But I received some alarming news yesterday ... those same power players are now putting their thumbs on the scale in our OPEN REPUBLICAN PRIMARY.

That's because they see what we see ... voters in the 47th District want to elect an outsider conservative. Someone who isn't a career politician and won't be a part of Washington's business-as-usual.

They don't want YOU to decide this election. They want this race to be decided by DC.

I'm not backing down, Peter, and I bet you won't either. We're going to win this thing if we stand together.

That's why I'm asking you to contribute whatever you can to send a message to Washington that WE will decide this election! (https://secure.anedot.com/max-ukropina-for-congress-2024/drain-the-swamp?utm_medium=Email&utm_source=Ukropina&utm_campaign=Make_Them_Listen_112923&utm_source=Max+for+OC+Supporters&utm_campaign=ecf285fdb4-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_24_03_09_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f436e3f042-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Friend,

[](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJxEj72unDAQhZ9m6EB4DHi3oLgJIlWKFHfbyNgDOPEPMrYQbx-BVrnlnO_TnBnpNmvmswfxDRBXo3dABP4BiDnxl_z8_BnP8vj1Uf5oX7hcEL8DYjo3-m--l1TkpLFXKoZC9w1KNquCeiZqxh_YiaZY-6kVNHfUMPZodK1VjZra9vFsJyWehG1heqyRM8ZrRCY4q56TYhMxegjR6Zk9oanvomqORGk1_i9FLY09KxVcYfs1pW2_DxsBx51UjlQdxkfSlwE4eplM8NKWKvg9mZTfo5VHmb0JHnD805VzCEkuVLqpDA74mJP7vYccFQEfvjhgdxFH2mQHfLgq7kRJt0mzeOCDm95Zong5c9IMsJMuZJ-AD9gWsdfbYaw1eyegqZf7RRXcvwAAAP__QWGElg) New Speaker of the House Mike Johnson has started releasing thousands of hours of footage from the January 6th protests at the Capitol.

**It is long overdue.**

Before I tell you why, let me explain who I am.

My name is John Pierce. After serving in the United States Army, I graduated from Harvard Law, where I served as one of the very rare CONSERVATIVE former editors of the _Harvard Law Review_.

I walked away from my corporate law practice because our nation needs a litigator who could go the distance against the God-like powers of the government.

Trials are combat and make no mistake, when the federal government is trying to toss your client in prison, they don't hesitate to break the law themselves to make that happen.

I know this first-hand and have been living it for months as I currently represent 27 January 6th Defendants through my organization, the National Constitutional Law Union, NCLU.

More than ever, **[we need your support to keep going](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJxEj72unDAQhZ9m6EB4DHi3oLgJIlWKFHfbyNgDOPEPMrYQbx-BVrnlnO_TnBnpNmvmswfxDRBXo3dABP4BiDnxl_z8_BnP8vj1Uf5oX7hcEL8DYjo3-m--l1TkpLFXKoZC9w1KNquCeiZqxh_YiaZY-6kVNHfUMPZodK1VjZra9vFsJyWehG1heqyRM8ZrRCY4q56TYhMxegjR6Zk9oanvomqORGk1_i9FLY09KxVcYfs1pW2_DxsBx51UjlQdxkfSlwE4eplM8NKWKvg9mZTfo5VHmb0JHnD805VzCEkuVLqpDA74mJP7vYccFQEfvjhgdxFH2mQHfLgq7kRJt0mzeOCDm95Zong5c9IMsJMuZJ-AD9gWsdfbYaw1eyegqZf7RRXcvwAAAP__QWGElg).**

The cost of litigation for most clients would be overwhelming, and NCLU does all it can to ease the burden of these families who have already been devastated and separated by jail time.

My travel costs alone, which place me in DC temporary housing for months, have me coming out of already thin pockets. **[Any amount you can donate helps us tremendously, and I cannot express my gratitude enough for your support](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJxEj72unDAQhZ9m6EB4DHi3oLgJIlWKFHfbyNgDOPEPMrYQbx-BVrnlnO_TnBnpNmvmswfxDRBXo3dABP4BiDnxl_z8_BnP8vj1Uf5oX7hcEL8DYjo3-m--l1TkpLFXKoZC9w1KNquCeiZqxh_YiaZY-6kVNHfUMPZodK1VjZra9vFsJyWehG1heqyRM8ZrRCY4q56TYhMxegjR6Zk9oanvomqORGk1_i9FLY09KxVcYfs1pW2_DxsBx51UjlQdxkfSlwE4eplM8NKWKvg9mZTfo5VHmb0JHnD805VzCEkuVLqpDA74mJP7vYccFQEfvjhgdxFH2mQHfLgq7kRJt0mzeOCDm95Zong5c9IMsJMuZJ-AD9gWsdfbYaw1eyegqZf7RRXcvwAAAP__QWGElg). **

Now, I've already overseen eleven trials for J6 defendants with more success than any lawyer in the country. Sentencing for our client Joe Thomas just concluded, and the government was demanding incarceration for ten years with immediate arrest. NCLU was able to reduce that to four years and ten months with a voluntary self-surrender. This gives him a few months to get his affairs in order so his family can endure the hardship.

But we're not done fighting for Joe or anyone else!

Our cases are making their way through appellate courts, and with the release of the January 6th footage, the door opens to _writs of_ _habeas corpus_.

In the appellate court, we must be granted a new trial to introduce new evidence and be able to use the newly released footage from the Capitol. _Habeas corpus_ will give us a fighting chance to prove our clients are being held illegally.

If you have seen any of this footage, **it is jaw-dropping**.

There are scenes of Americans protecting lines of police from attacks by Antifa agitators. In other areas, U.S. Capitol Police are seen escorting and giving a tour to peaceful protesters within the halls of Congress. Additional police are on film directing protesters to the Capitol.

**And our defendants are in the footage!**

Let me be candid: NCLU has me and the partial time of a handful of other attorneys. With my litigation schedule, my time is already nonexistent. I barely have time to eat and get a haircut.

**I need to bring on more support for the best chance to get these men and women back home where they belong. [Will you donate and help NCLU fight for these Americans? ](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJxEj72unDAQhZ9m6EB4DHi3oLgJIlWKFHfbyNgDOPEPMrYQbx-BVrnlnO_TnBnpNmvmswfxDRBXo3dABP4BiDnxl_z8_BnP8vj1Uf5oX7hcEL8DYjo3-m--l1TkpLFXKoZC9w1KNquCeiZqxh_YiaZY-6kVNHfUMPZodK1VjZra9vFsJyWehG1heqyRM8ZrRCY4q56TYhMxegjR6Zk9oanvomqORGk1_i9FLY09KxVcYfs1pW2_DxsBx51UjlQdxkfSlwE4eplM8NKWKvg9mZTfo5VHmb0JHnD805VzCEkuVLqpDA74mJP7vYccFQEfvjhgdxFH2mQHfLgq7kRJt0mzeOCDm95Zong5c9IMsJMuZJ-AD9gWsdfbYaw1eyegqZf7RRXcvwAAAP__QWGElg)**

To give you an idea of what I have in front of me, here's the partial trial schedule for NCLU's January 6th Defendants:

01/08/24 - Michael Dillon

And that's only what's been scheduled so far.

As I mentioned, travel and lodging in the Swamp is running us thousands of dollars each week for me and the NCLU staff.

**[Will you chip in to help cover our costs?](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJxEj72unDAQhZ9m6EB4DHi3oLgJIlWKFHfbyNgDOPEPMrYQbx-BVrnlnO_TnBnpNmvmswfxDRBXo3dABP4BiDnxl_z8_BnP8vj1Uf5oX7hcEL8DYjo3-m--l1TkpLFXKoZC9w1KNquCeiZqxh_YiaZY-6kVNHfUMPZodK1VjZra9vFsJyWehG1heqyRM8ZrRCY4q56TYhMxegjR6Zk9oanvomqORGk1_i9FLY09KxVcYfs1pW2_DxsBx51UjlQdxkfSlwE4eplM8NKWKvg9mZTfo5VHmb0JHnD805VzCEkuVLqpDA74mJP7vYccFQEfvjhgdxFH2mQHfLgq7kRJt0mzeOCDm95Zong5c9IMsJMuZJ-AD9gWsdfbYaw1eyegqZf7RRXcvwAAAP__QWGElg)**

New House Speaker Mike Johnson started releasing thousands of hours of footage from the January 6th protests at the Capitol. | Friend, New Speaker of the House Mike Johnson has started releasing thousands of hours of footage from the January 6th protests at the Capitol. It is long overdue. Before I tell you why, let me explain who I am. My name is John Pierce. After serving in the United States Army, I graduated from Harvard Law, where I served as one of the very rare CONSERVATIVE former editors of the Harvard Law Review. I walked away from my corporate law practice because our nation needs a litigator who could go the distance against the God-like powers of the government. Trials are combat and make no mistake, when the federal government is trying to toss your client in prison, they don't hesitate to break the law themselves to make that happen. I know this first-hand and have been living it for months as I currently represent 27 January 6th Defendants through my organization, the National Constitutional Law Union, NCLU. More than ever, . The cost of litigation for most clients would be overwhelming, and NCLU does all it can to ease the burden of these families who have already been devastated and separated by jail time. My travel costs alone, which place me in DC temporary housing for months, have me coming out of already thin pockets. . Now, I've already overseen eleven trials for J6 defendants with more success than any lawyer in the country. Sentencing for our client Joe Thomas just concluded, and the government was demanding incarceration for ten years with immediate arrest. NCLU was able to reduce that to four years and ten months with a voluntary self-surrender. This gives him a few months to get his affairs in order so his family can endure the hardship. But we're not done fighting for Joe or anyone else! Our cases are making their way through appellate courts, and with the release of the January 6th footage, the door opens to writs of habeas corpus. In the appellate court, we must be granted a new trial to introduce new evidence and be able to use the newly released footage from the Capitol. Habeas corpus will give us a fighting chance to prove our clients are being held illegally. If you have seen any of this footage, it is jaw-dropping. There are scenes of Americans protecting lines of police from attacks by Antifa agitators. In other areas, U.S. Capitol Police are seen escorting and giving a tour to peaceful protesters within the halls of Congress. Additional police are on film directing protesters to the Capitol. And our defendants are in the footage! Let me be candid: NCLU has me and the partial time of a handful of other attorneys. With my litigation schedule, my time is already nonexistent. I barely have time to eat and get a haircut. I need to bring on more support for the best chance to get these men and women back home where they belong. To give you an idea of what I have in front of me, here's the partial trial schedule for NCLU's January 6th Defendants: 12/15/23 - John George Todd III 01/08/24 - Michael Dillon 01/22/24 - Jesse James Rumson 02/12/24 - Robert Westbury, Jonah Westbury, Isaac Westbury and Aaron James 02/26/24 - Stephanie Baez 03/04/24 - Michael Brock 03/18/24 - Patrick Montgomery 03/25/24 - Rebecca Lavrenz 04/08/24 - Jared Kastner 05/20/24 - Deborah Lee And that's only what's been scheduled so far. As I mentioned, travel and lodging in the Swamp is running us thousands of dollars each week for me and the NCLU staff. These Americans require our help. Thank you for your time and support. I cannot thank you enough, and I'll be in touch soon with more updates. In Vigilance, John M.
